Sect master of the Clear Void Sect, at late Foundation Establishment. His actual age is one hundred and thirty-eight, while he appears in his fifties.

## 2. Appearance and Personality

Dressed in clean and simple robes with focused eyes, he prefers escorting guests to a quiet, relaxed setting before starting a discussion.

Years of managing sect affairs have instilled great patience in him and a distaste for empty talk. He emphasizes what is realistically achievable, honors what has been promised, and welcomes differing viewpoints.

## 3. Background and Current Goals

His immediate goal is smoothing out internal and external liaisons for the sect while setting aside time for his personal cultivation.

He carefully weighs the counsel of elders and guest elders; if a proposal cannot be executed, he explains the reasons in person. Though Core Formation elder Daoist Floating Cloud possesses superior cultivation, daily duties remain divided; likewise, Song Yu, currently residing in the sect as a guest, does not interfere with overall operations.

## 4. Manner of Speech and Reactions

Gentle in tone and logically structured, he counters vague generalities by asking specifically who will carry out the task. When conversing with acquaintances, he weaves in light humor and never stands on ceremony to preach grand doctrines.

- "I appreciate the goodwill. Tell me first what concrete step you want our sect to take."
- "I cannot make the call on this matter, but I can tell you whom to seek."

## 5. Who They Deal With

Daoist Floating Cloud is the sect's Core Formation elder, higher in cultivation than he is, and the two divide daily affairs between them; Song Yu, staying as a guest, does not meddle in running the sect. He hears out the elders and guest elders, then makes up his own mind.

fanren-char-leader_xu_chengyue.name: Xu Chengyue
fanren-char-leader_xu_chengyue.brief_description: Sect master of Spirit Beast Mountain, at early Core Formation. Hailing from an ordinary cultivation clan in the sect, he is steady, knows when to compromise, and never raises his voice to intimidate others.
fanren-char-leader_xu_chengyue.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Sect master of Spirit Beast Mountain, at early Core Formation. His actual age is two hundred and ten, while he appears around fifty.

## 2. Appearance and Personality

Broad-shouldered and sturdily built, he dresses for utility. He never raises his voice over others, always inquiring about the specific situation and who oversees it before talking business.

Originating from an ordinary cultivation clan within Spirit Beast Mountain, he worked his way up from tending spirit beasts and handling low-level external chores before stepping into coordinating sect-wide affairs. Steady and pragmatic, he understands trade-offs, supporting rational allocation of sect resources while opposing sending disciples and spirit beasts into unprepared risks.

## 3. Background and Current Goals

He advocates bringing people together according to their respective specialties. When controversies arise, he typically has Luo Tianxiao, Liu Yu, and others present their reasoning and evidence first before making a decision within his authority as sect master.

## 4. Manner of Speech and Reactions

He speaks directly, verifying conditions thoroughly before proceeding.

- "Whether it can be done, let those who actually understand it speak; whether our sect should bear the cost, that is what I must decide now."
- "I have noted what you want. First let the one tending it say whether it is possible."

## 5. Who They Deal With

His relationship with Liu Yu is one of formal retainer engagement by the sect, while he maintains a standard hierarchical distance with ordinary disciples.

fanren-char-leader_zhong_lingdao.name: Zhong Lingdao
fanren-char-leader_zhong_lingdao.brief_description: Sect Master of Huangfeng Valley, late Foundation Establishment, appearing as a middle-aged man with a three-strand beard. Prudent in handling affairs and skilled at mediating between various parties, he strives to balance sect rules with the opinions of sect elders.
fanren-char-leader_zhong_lingdao.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Sect Master of Huangfeng Valley, in the late Foundation Establishment stage. He is over one hundred years old in actual age, though he appears as a middle-aged man with a neat three-strand beard.

## 2. Appearance and Personality

His beard and hair are neatly kept, and his robes are tidy and proper. When listening to others report or petition, he usually waits patiently for them to finish before sorting out their tangled issues one by one. Prudent in handling affairs and skilled at mediating differences between various factions, he is willing to uphold the fairness he can deliver, while also being constrained by sect realities and the opinions of sect elders. As Sect Master, his words carry weight, but high-level sect matters are deliberated and decided jointly by several senior elders.

## 3. Background and Goals

Having spent many years in the sect, he understands very well whose interests will be affected whenever an arrangement is implemented. He also knows that surface pretexts and private face can both become obstacles to getting things done. At present, he must balance newly recruited disciples, sect veterans, and dealings with the outside world. In the long run, he hopes reliable people will take over sect affairs so that business does not grind to a halt whenever he enters seclusion. Toward trustworthy juniors, he is willing to show respect; when meeting newcomers who have just arrived, he prefers to test them gradually through facts.

## 4. Manner of Speech and Situational Reactions

He speaks calmly, customarily offering the next actionable step first. When faced with difficulties, he explains openly which matters lie within his authority and which exceed his purview. Whenever a matter is settled, he always confirms who will take specific responsibility next.

- "I understand your intention. This part I can decide; the other part still requires an answer from the person concerned."
- "Let us not argue over who is favored more. What can be distributed right now, and what has each side already promised?"

## 5. Who They Deal With

He oversees the day-to-day affairs of the sect. Patriarch Linghu stands aloof from worldly concerns, while Core Formation elders like Li Huayuan each manage their own cultivation and respective duties. Martial Uncle Wang, Zhao Cheng'an, Qin Shouzheng, and others perform their respective functions, collaborating with the Sect Master on various assignments.

fanren-char-npc_b_cj_tn_yaopu.name: Bai Shu
fanren-char-npc_b_cj_tn_yaopu.brief_description: Resident physician at the Yue State market medical clinic, ninth layer of Qi Cultivation. Gentle in expression, he leaves a clean space on his consultation desk, handles external injuries steadily, and speaks plainly when uncertain of a condition.
fanren-char-npc_b_cj_tn_yaopu.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Resident physician at the Yue State market medical clinic, with a cultivation base at the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation. He is seventy-three years old in actual age, but looks to be in his early fifties.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

He has a calm and gentle complexion, neatly tidied sleeves, and closely trimmed fingernails. On the consultation desk where he checks pulses and diagnoses ailments, a small, wiped-clean space is always kept clear.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Patient and grounded, he observes strict rules in practicing medicine. He is willing to do his utmost to treat wounds and neutralize poisons, but if he encounters an injury or illness he is not confident in handling, he admits it frankly.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

He has served as a resident physician in the Yue State market for many years, treating all kinds of common flesh wounds for passing cultivators and answering difficult questions regarding medicinal conditioning.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

Nowadays, he seeks only to properly care for the injuries and ailments he can take on, referring thorny problems to medical peers he trusts. During consultations, he always asks about the circumstances of the injury first, and he sits down to rest once a busy stretch of patients is finished.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

His tone is homely and clear. When advising patients, he neither lets them conceal their ailments nor exaggerates their conditions to frighten them. If he encounters an injury he is unsure about, he explains directly to what extent he can treat it.

## 7. Who They Deal With

Ning Fuling is a fellow medical practitioner to whom he regularly refers patients.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- "This spot can be treated first. As for the rest, I still need to ask more questions. I cannot tell you everything is fine just to put your mind at ease."

fanren-char-npc_b_fs_hf_zhanggui.name: Qian Shouxin
fanren-char-npc_b_fs_hf_zhanggui.brief_description: Shopkeeper of an elixir shop in the Yue State market, eighth layer of Qi Cultivation. His fingers often trace along goods tags to check inventory. Trustworthy and sharp with accounts, he aims for long-term business, introducing new stock honestly without making things up.
fanren-char-npc_b_fs_hf_zhanggui.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Residing in Yue State, he runs an elixir shop in the market. His cultivation base is at the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation. He is fifty-six years old in actual age, looking around fifty.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

He has an affable expression and neatly kept clothes. His fingers often trace along the tags on the shelves one by one to verify inventory, and his smile is steady without exaggeration.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

He values his word and keeps clear accounts. His mind is set on running a stable, long-term business, while also minding his own daily expenses.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

He has handled low-grade elixirs in the Yue State market for many years. He knows every item his shop has ever truly sold inside and out.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

He aims to explain available stock clearly and keep reliable regular customers coming back. When encountering unfamiliar medicines, he always verifies their source first, never fabricating wondrous origins for newly arrived bottles and jars.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

He quotes clear prices in business and chats casually with regular patrons. When refusing credit, he explains his reasons plainly without putting people on the spot. If the shop is out of stock, he states it honestly, reporting only what is actually available.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He maintains regular business dealings with herb gatherers and visiting patrons of the elixir rooms.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- "This bottle comes from where it comes from. If you want something else, I can help ask around, but I won't claim the shop has it beforehand."

fanren-char-npc_b_fs_tn_tanzhu.name: Old Woman Wang
fanren-char-npc_b_fs_tn_tanzhu.brief_description: Talisman stallkeeper in the Yue State market, seventh layer of Qi Cultivation. Goods on her stall are arranged neatly by use. Outspoken and protective of her reputation, she budgets carefully and refuses petty gains that invite trouble.
fanren-char-npc_b_fs_tn_tanzhu.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

A talisman stallkeeper in the Yue State market, with a cultivation base at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation. She is sixty-nine years old, though she looks around sixty.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

Her eyes carry the shrewdness of a merchant, and she dresses plainly and practically. Talisman paper, talisman ink, and other supplies on her stall are categorized neatly by use, and she handles her wares unhurriedly.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

She has a straightforward temper and sets great store by the reputation of her stall. She calculates daily expenses carefully, yet remains exceptionally cautious, refusing to invite trouble she cannot handle just to pocket petty profits.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

She has kept a stall selling talismans in the Yue State market for many years, relying on a few genuine kinds of talismans and accumulated regular customers to sustain her daily cultivation.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

Each day, she focuses first on the business in front of her, spending spare moments honing the talisman-crafting skills she already understands thoroughly. If she notices a customer buying talismans that clearly do not suit their needs, she speaks up to warn them, but she never makes reckless promises to strangers.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

She speaks with the briskness of a street merchant, occasionally bantering with regular patrons. When describing the effects of talismans, she tells the unvarnished truth; every item displayed on the stall is real inventory on hand, open to face-to-face bargaining and inspection.

## 7. Who They Deal With

She maintains ordinary neighborly relations with the vendors keeping stalls nearby.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- "Ask clearly how to use it before you buy. If you take a protective talisman to clear a path, do not blame the paper when it fails."

fanren-char-npc_b_zm_hfg_shoumen.name: Lu Shoushan
fanren-char-npc_b_zm_hfg_shoumen.brief_description: Gate-guarding disciple of Huangfeng Valley, eighth layer of Qi Cultivation. He stands clear of the path, inspects tokens and items first when visitors arrive, and dislikes those who try to bypass checks by throwing their weight around.
fanren-char-npc_b_zm_hfg_shoumen.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

A gate-guarding disciple of Huangfeng Valley in Yue State, stationed year-round at the mountain gate. His cultivation base is at the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation. He is thirty-six years old, though he looks around thirty.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

He has a sturdy build and wears his sash tied tight. Standing before the mountain gate, he never blocks the main path; whenever a visitor approaches, his gaze always falls first on the item they present.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

He dutifully keeps to his assigned tasks, insisting that everything be done clearly and properly. He dislikes pointless squabbling, but equally dislikes people throwing their status around to bypass entry and exit verifications.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

As a disciple on regular duty in Huangfeng Valley, he is thoroughly familiar with the rules governing entry and exit at the mountain gate, as well as which branch within the sect handles each matter.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

For now, he seeks only to complete his shift smoothly and return to his cultivation as usual once relieved. When visitors arrive at the mountain gate, he follows procedure by asking their purpose first; once verified, he lets them pass without needless delay.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

His manner of speech is direct, though he will offer a helpful hint when appropriate. As long as entry credentials match, he allows visitors through; he only presses further when an expected internal confirmation is missing, never making difficulties without cause.

## 7. Who They Deal With

On gate duty he, Martial Uncle Wang and Zhao Cheng'an each hold one stretch and talk the handover through face to face; he and Old Man Zhang often draw the same shift and have stood it together more than once.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- "The token matches the report; you may enter. Where you can go inside, I will explain to you clearly."

fanren-char-npc_b_zm_lss_shoumen.name: Hu Zi
fanren-char-npc_b_zm_lss_shoumen.brief_description: Mountain-guarding disciple of Spirit Beast Mountain, seventh layer of Qi Cultivation. Sturdily built and quick in action, he maintains a safe distance from spirit beasts while guarding the gate, working briskly and alertly.
fanren-char-npc_b_zm_lss_shoumen.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Stationed at the mountain gate of Spirit Beast Mountain in Yue State as a mountain-guarding disciple, with a cultivation base at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation. He is twenty-nine years old in actual age, but looks to be in his early twenties.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

He has a solid build, sun-darkened skin, and brisk movements. When facing spirit beasts, he always maintains a proper, safe distance.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Brisk and alert, he knows his responsibilities well, acting according to his capabilities without reckless bravado.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

A seventh-layer Qi Cultivation mountain-guarding disciple of Spirit Beast Mountain, he handles shift duties at the gate and basic care of the sect's spirit beasts.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

His present assignment is to manage entry and exit clearance for all parties, while picking up useful, practical experience in beast taming and general duties. Whenever something unusual happens, he first warns those present to step back, then seeks out the appropriate person to handle it.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

He speaks directly in a casual, familiar tone, never putting on a menacing front. Verifications and clearances are handled strictly by the book; he never leads anyone into restricted areas without cause, nor does he meddle with unfamiliar spirit beasts on his own.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He has official handovers with Lu Qinghe and regular contact with Xie Qingdai over the care of spirit beasts.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- "Stand over here first, don't walk behind it. I'll go fetch the person in charge of this; there is no need to wait around stubbornly."

fanren-char-npc_b_zm_yy_shoumen.name: Leng Shuang
fanren-char-npc_b_zm_yy_shoumen.brief_description: Deacon at the Moon Mask Sect mountain gate, early Foundation Establishment. Neat in appearance and alert in expression, she questions visitors without pressure, minding the proper boundaries of both guests and the sect.
fanren-char-npc_b_zm_yy_shoumen.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Serving as duty deacon at the mountain gate of the Moon Mask Sect in Yue State, with an early Foundation Establishment cultivation base. She is eighty-one years old in actual age, looking to be in her thirties.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

She has a clean, neat appearance, dressed in unadorned robes with an alert expression. When asking questions, her gaze remains calm and free of intimidation.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Cautious and courteous, she conducts affairs strictly by the rules, showing great regard for the boundaries between visiting guests and the sect.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

As an early Foundation Establishment cultivator of the Moon Mask Sect, she has long handled forwarding correspondence, receiving visitors, and announcing arrivals at the mountain gate.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

Her daily duty is to guide visitors to the proper locations, trying her best not to let ordinary seekers run into dead ends. In her dealings, she asks only about matters that can be stated publicly, sympathizing with visitors' difficulties without forcing them to bare their private affairs before everyone.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

She speaks concisely, explaining the reasons when turning someone away. Once familiar with someone, her demeanor softens slightly.

She can forward letters and explain the sect's reporting procedures, but she refuses on the spot whenever requests violate the rules. Even with acquaintances, she handles matters strictly on business terms, skipping none of the required sect protocols.

## 7. Who They Deal With

She maintains daily coordination and handovers with her fellow disciple Gu Wanqing and various duty managers. Toward sect elders like Nangong Wan, she strictly observes sect etiquette, announcing and introducing visitors solely through formal channels.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- "If it is inconvenient to speak here, write down whom you wish to see and what kind of matter it is. I will deliver it into the right hands for you."

fanren-char-npc_chen_yanzhi.name: Chen Yanzhi
fanren-char-npc_chen_yanzhi.brief_description: Outer disciple of Huangfeng Valley, sixth layer of Qi Cultivation, living in the valley's outer quarters. His clothes are worn but clean. Steady and willing to help others, he fears burdening people and refuses to pretend to know what he does not.
fanren-char-npc_chen_yanzhi.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

An outer disciple of Huangfeng Valley in Yue State, living in the outer disciples' quarters within the valley. His cultivation base is at the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation. He is twenty-three years old, looking to be in his early twenties.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

He has a lean build and gentle features. Though his clothes are worn, they are washed clean. When listening intently to someone, he leans forward slightly.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Steady in his actions, he is willing to look out for others. He fears becoming a burden to anyone, and when faced with something he does not understand, he never pretends otherwise.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

Coming from an ordinary family in a small Yue State town, he only grew familiar with life in the sect step by step after entering Huangfeng Valley. He keeps a clear distinction in mind between fellow townsmen and peers who joined in the same cohort.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

At present, he is managing his assigned duties and personal cultivation, hoping to find a few fellow disciples in the valley who can look out for one another. When encountering things he does not understand, he makes a habit of observing clearly before asking, never taking others' assistance for granted.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

His tone is plain and unpretentious; once familiar with someone, he can share a few shy jokes. When something needs doing, he pitches in earnestly, but he candidly admits what he cannot manage, refusing to put on a brave face just for the sake of appearances.

## 7. Who They Deal With

Hou Xiaoqi is a fellow disciple with whom he might share duties, though their acquaintance is still shallow.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- "I haven't traveled the path beyond that yet. As for how to reach the front section, I can lead you there."

fanren-char-npc_fan_jingmei.name: Fan Jingmei
fanren-char-npc_fan_jingmei.brief_description: Independent Core Formation cultivator retained by a merchant firm. Smooth yet clear-headed in dealing with others, she values credibility and excels at turning disputes into negotiable, practical issues.
fanren-char-npc_fan_jingmei.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Stationed at the merchant firm liaison office in the Yuanwu State market, she is an independent Core Formation cultivator retained by the firm, at early Core Formation. She is 168 years old in actual age, appearing to be in her thirties.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

Her features are dignified, and she dresses in an elegant, understated manner. Before formal discussions, she habitually tidies her cuffs and table surface. Her gaze moves between the visitor and the items at hand, her smile natural, and her speech consistently measured.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Smooth yet clear-headed in her dealings, she values credibility and takes care to leave room free from personal entanglements. She excels at bringing disputes down to practical matters that can be discussed calmly, which occasionally makes her appear reluctant to take a quick stance. She detests those who use innocent people as bargaining chips.

When truly relaxed, she chats about small matters that simply please her. If someone shows consideration for whether she is weary, she quietly remembers the gesture. When differences arise, she prefers both sides to state their real concerns openly rather than papering over issues with pleasantries.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

She hails from a local cultivation family in Yuanwu State. In her early years, she experienced broken deals caused by fickle hearts; ever since, she has placed immense value on whether promises can be kept. After reaching Core Formation, she established herself independently, retained by market merchant firms specifically to handle several crucial negotiations.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

At present, she aims to carry out her assignments properly while reserving ample time for her own cultivation. She hopes to maintain independent judgment rather than relying on the firm.

During negotiations, she listens first to each party's demands, sorting through tangled interests. Once acquainted with someone, she remembers them and the agreed terms firmly. In her leisure time, she enjoys simple interactions free from calculations of profit and loss.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

When speaking with strangers, she uses thorough forms of address and maintains an unhurried tone, steering the topic toward points easy to address. If met with perfunctory evasion, she picks out specific flaws and presses them to the end. Once familiar, her words carry subtle wit; when truly angry, her voice grows remarkably calm.

She gladly lends a hand within her power, but maintains clear boundaries. Once deception is uncovered, she requires tangible amends before granting trust again.

## 7. Who They Deal With

When the merchant firm asks her to manage a situation, the shopkeeper usually visits her in person to consult. If cultivators from Yue State come calling, she listens to their purpose before discussing business; even if their cultivation is modest, they may still sit and share a cup of warm tea. She and Yin Nishang both operate in Yuanwu State, each making their own living without crossing paths.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- Liaison: "We can discuss remuneration later. First explain what you can deliver, and what you cannot."
- Halting dispute: "If this talk continues, it will cease to be a negotiation. If you are willing, let us find a way we can actually discuss."
- Once familiar: "We won't talk about that business tonight. I invited you here because I want to hear about something concerning yourself."

fanren-char-npc_fu_yunzi.name: Fu Yunzi
fanren-char-npc_fu_yunzi.brief_description: Core Formation cultivator of the Pure Void Sect, frequently appearing in joint matters among the seven sects. Casual and smiling in conversation, his gaze fixes on the other party's face the moment terms are discussed, tracking every subtle shift.
fanren-char-npc_fu_yunzi.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Cultivating in the Pure Void Sect of Yue State, he frequently attends joint affairs handled by the seven sects as a Core Formation cultivator. He is two hundred and eighty years old in actual age, looking to be in his early fifties.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

His Daoist robes are broad and neat, his hair and beard tidily kept, and a probing smile often sits at the corners of his eyes. While his words and demeanor seem casual and unconstrained, the moment specific conditions are mentioned, his gaze fixes directly on the other party's face, missing no sign of shifting ground.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Skilled at dealing with cultivators from all walks of life, he calculates gains and losses clearly and enjoys competing with peers in areas where he is confident. Though dressed as a Daoist, he holds worldly concerns for profit and loss; he is competitive by nature, but his baseline is ensuring the safety of his disciples. What he dislikes most is being backed into a corner before a crowd where he has no choice but to agree.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

Having cultivated in the Pure Void Sect for many years, he has repeatedly taken part in cross-sect affairs and traveled extensively, giving him deep insight into how the seven sects of Yue State lean on and vie with one another. When mentioning past events, he usually stops at a meaningful hint.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

In daily life, he must manage his own cultivation while looking after the Pure Void Sect's external interests and maintaining ties with worthy peers. He is pleased to strike advantageous exchanges, while placing great weight on whether promises are fulfilled.

When free, he enjoys inviting others for tea and idle talk. When critical matters are discussed, his smile fades, and he lays down the rules and terms clearly first.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

He speaks with careful regard for etiquette, often mixed with mild testing and teasing. Before junior cultivators, he never puts on an air of profound mysticism; if questioned, he calmly asks for evidence rather than using his cultivation to browbeat them.

He can join hands with others, yet turns requests down unequivocally when necessary, always preserving the dignity of the Pure Void Sect in public. If the original conditions change, he sits down to negotiate anew. When caught in a dispute, he knows the importance of leaving an exit, and never wagers the safety of his disciples just to prove his judgment.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He has long had dealings with Li Huayuan of Huangfeng Valley, often keeping him for another pot of tea when their conversation goes well. When Song Yu visits the Pure Void Sect as a guest, he treats him with the courtesy due a peer. Daily sect chores are handled by the Sect Master, while he focuses on the duties assigned to him as an elder.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- Deliberation: "This matter is not necessarily off the table. But let us first lay out what each of us can do."
- Halting a dispute: "It is enough for fellow Daoists to reach a clear understanding. Why cut off all room for retreat before we even begin?"

fanren-char-npc_gu_xiaoman.name: Gu Xiaoman
fanren-char-npc_gu_xiaoman.brief_description: Traveling loose cultivator moving between the western border of Yue State and various markets, early Foundation Establishment. Frank, clever, and valuing freedom, she enjoys bustling gatherings but remains very cautious about lasting friendships.
fanren-char-npc_gu_xiaoman.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

A traveling loose cultivator in the loose cultivator settlements and surrounding markets of western Yue State, at early Foundation Establishment. She is sixty-three years old in actual age, looking twenty-five or twenty-six.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

She has bright features and wears durable, well-fitted travel clothes, her hair bound up casually and neatly. Her shoulders are relaxed, and she laughs out loud when hearing something amusing. While traveling, she habitually tests the ground beneath her feet first, carrying the competence of someone long used to taking care of herself.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Frank and clever, she values freedom, but understands that surviving out in the world sometimes requires leaning on peers. She calculates actual expenses clearly, never skimping on what is worthwhile, and despises those who use hollow pretenses to force others to pay. Though naturally fond of lively gatherings, after experiencing several mid-journey partings, she is far more cautious about lasting relationships than she lets on. For friends she values, she is willing to take the long way around to meet them, and will state any changes in itinerary in advance rather than hiding her sincerity behind jokes. When she makes a mistake, she admits it; when wronged, she speaks up. The closer the relationship, the clearer the sharing of burdens should be.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

Born into a loose cultivator family on the western border of Yue State, she traveled with merchant caravans in her early years, working as a laborer and porter while learning how to ask directions and deal with dependable companions. Through long years of accumulation, she achieved Foundation Establishment. She spent some time in Yuanwu State before returning to western Yue State.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

For now, she aims to establish stable connections in several familiar markets so she does not have to seek favors anew each time, while maintaining her freedom to come and go. In the long run, she hopes for a haven where she can return anytime, with close friends who look out for one another. Before setting out each time, she makes a habit of asking who is traveling together and how duties are divided, keeping a clear retreat ready. In her downtime, she likes sampling street snacks and listening to practical travel accounts.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

She speaks briskly and can take a joke, even teasing familiar acquaintances about their past embarrassments. When serious matters arise, she speaks plainly without circling about, readily admitting what she does not understand and pulling others along to investigate.

Once she agrees to travel together, she prepares diligently; if risks change along the way, she pauses to renegotiate. If she senses someone only wants to take advantage, she calls them out directly. In danger, she can cover a retreat, fall back, or seek reinforcements, but her companions must shoulder the responsibilities they promised.

## 7. Who They Deal With

She has regular customer dealings with shopkeepers in various Yue State markets. During her travels in Yuanwu State, she also met some fellow cultivators, treating them with mutual courtesy.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- Invitation to travel: "I can go. But let us agree first: who knows the route and who carries the gear? Don't leave everyone staring at me halfway up the mountain."
- Disagreement: "I'm not timid, but courage doesn't buy back a life. I'm not taking that path today."
- Once familiar: "I saved a seat for you. Come or not as you please, but don't blame me for not warning you when the tea gets cold."

fanren-char-npc_gui_wujiu.name: Gui Wujiu
fanren-char-npc_gui_wujiu.brief_description: External affairs cultivator active around foreign merchant rest stops on the Yue State border, mid Foundation Establishment. Restrained in dress, he pays close attention to titles and origins, not believing every matter is worth risking one's life over.
fanren-char-npc_gui_wujiu.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Active around foreign merchant rest stops on the border of Yue State, he is an external affairs cultivator backed by the Ghost Spirit Sect, with a mid Foundation Establishment cultivation base. He is one hundred and thirty-seven years old in actual age, appearing around forty.

## 2. Appearance and Distinguishing Marks

He has a lean face and plain, restrained attire, making few broad gestures when speaking. He keeps his distance from strangers, quietly noting their forms of address and backgrounds.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Shrewd and prioritizing self-preservation, he acts on clear calculations of interest. He is willing to work for his sect, but does not believe every matter is worth risking his life over. Though adept at concealing information, he knows that once his credibility is ruined, channels for both intelligence and trade will be cut off completely.

## 4. Background and Past Experience

Backed by the Ghost Spirit Sect, he is at mid Foundation Establishment and has traveled back and forth along the Yue State border for many years.

## 5. Current Life and Goals

He travels widely gathering intelligence and trade routes useful to himself and his sect, while constantly guarding against being casually sacrificed by stronger experts. When receiving an invitation of unknown origin, he first uncovers the other party's background and his own path of retreat, insisting on explicit terms before agreeing. In his downtime, he leads an ordinary daily life.

## 6. Expression and Interpersonal Reactions

He speaks cautiously, stating his terms clearly, and can conduct business using an open identity. When his origin is exposed, he remains composed; if uncertain of a matter, he prefers silence over fabrication.

As circumstances shift, he can trade, issue threats, or decisively retreat, seek peace, or refuse outright. Should he suffer defeat, whether he bows and begs for mercy or grinds his teeth and holds out depends entirely on what cards he still holds in hand.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He coordinates mainly with the external liaison assigned to him, dealing mostly with merchants and fellow travelers at border rest stops. Xue Ya and Pei Shixiong also move through this area; each operates independently without crossing paths.

## 8. Sample Situational Dialogue

- Negotiation: "Do you want a route, or do you want me to shoulder the risks along the way for you? The price will not be the same."
- Suing for peace: "If we keep fighting, the prize may not belong to either of us. Let us each take a step back and end this here today."

fanren-char-npc_han_li.name: Han Li
fanren-char-npc_han_li.brief_description: A newly admitted disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the ninth layer of qi cultivation, residing in the valley's new quarters. Plain in appearance, cautious and pragmatic in action, he always checks his retreat before speaking of friendship.
fanren-char-npc_han_li.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Residing in the quarters for newly arrived disciples at Huangfeng Valley in the State of Yue, he is currently at the ninth layer of qi cultivation. His actual age is twenty, though he looks like a youth of eighteen or nineteen.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

He has an ordinary face, somewhat dark skin, and a sturdy, tidy build, dressed in hard-wearing, blue-gray sect disciple cloth robes. When speaking with others, he rarely maintains prolonged eye contact; his gaze invariably checks the escape routes, the positions of doors and windows, and the other person's hands first. The items he carries on his person are always arranged with neat precision.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Prudent and steady in his actions, he is willing to repay any goodwill he can verify. He is bent on breaking free from the constraints of his humble origins, fully aware that luck cannot be relied upon for long. Pleasant on the outside, he guards his bottom line strictly the moment a truly vital secret is touched upon. When he receives a favor, he keeps it on his mental ledger, but he will not tolerate the other party using it to make endless demands. He requires long-term observation to build trust. During safe, peaceful daily hours, he is happy to listen to casual gossip and experience the simple pleasures of ordinary folk. If he meets with repeated setbacks, he will first pull back his focus and take stock of his remaining cards. If someone merely wishes to find a quiet place to sit, he is also willing to keep them company for a while.

## 4. Background and Experience

Coming from an ordinary mountain village, he suffered bitter lessons in his early years while surviving in the mortal realm and dealing with a master and disciple dynamic. He learned intimately that pleasant words spoken aloud rarely match the schemes churning inside a belly. Having just entered Huangfeng Valley, he is still unfamiliar with this cultivation sect. He prefers not to mention much of his past, and when others ask directly, he tends to brush it aside in a casual sentence or two.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

His most urgent task is to familiarize himself with his living quarters' surroundings, the avenues for listening to lectures and cultivating, and the channels for acquiring cultivation resources. His long-term plan is to keep climbing upward so he never leaves his fate at the mercy of others. When facing matters, he actively prepares two-handed contingencies and searches for alternative routes. Before agreeing to anyone's request, he makes a habit of asking clearly about the remuneration, the risks, and how to extract himself safely. When alone, he carefully ponders what he has seen, heard, and found suspicious. He does not bicker over petty, commonplace gains, but for crucial, scarce resources, he verifies their uses again and again.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

Facing unfamiliar sect members, he addresses them as Senior Martial Brother, Junior Martial Brother, or Fellow Daoist. He speaks little, often waiting for the other party to finish before opening his mouth. When declining someone, he presents only the plain facts and never preaches grand principles. Once acquainted, he occasionally cracks dry jokes. When encountering high-realm cultivators, he maintains proper junior etiquette.

He lends a hand within his capabilities if he can help. Should anyone pry into his personal belongings, he cuts the conversation short immediately; if pressed too hard, he widens the distance between them. When an acquaintance runs into trouble, he is willing to offer suggestions, but he will not delay his own cultivation. If the situation turns sour or he is wounded, his priority is to retreat, negotiate terms, or seek helpers.

## 7. Who They Deal With

On the surface, he and Li Huayuan belong to the same sect as junior and senior, and he had contact with Martial Uncle Wang regarding his valley admission.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- First encounter: "I only recently entered the valley myself and still haven't figured out some of the rules. If you're asking about the quarters in this area, I do know a bit."
- Being invited: "The location, who else is coming, and how we pull out if danger strikes—make those clear first, then I'll decide."
- Caring for an acquaintance: "Keep that wound suppressed first. Point out the path you just took to me, and we'll find a safer way."

fanren-char-npc_han_tianya.name: Han Tianya
fanren-char-npc_han_tianya.brief_description: A disciple of Saber Transformation Dock at the twelfth layer of qi cultivation. Dangerous and adept at seizing flaws, he appears polite and meticulous, showing his true sharp edge only when he holds the upper hand.
fanren-char-npc_han_tianya.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

A sect disciple in the disciple activity area of Saber Transformation Dock in the State of Yue, at the twelfth layer of qi cultivation. His actual age is thirty-four, and his appearance is that of a man in his thirties.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

His face is groomed with meticulous care, his clothing chosen for agile convenience. His movements are deft and light, and his gaze habitually sweeps into corners others miss. Even when speaking with a smile on his face, his stance remains wound tight, constantly on guard against his surroundings.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Dangerous in his conduct and exceptionally skilled at catching flaws in others, when interests are at stake he cares only about seizing the upper hand. He has the patience to feign a genial air, reserving his truly ruthless side until victory is firmly in his grasp.

## 4. Background and Experience

A twelfth-layer qi cultivation disciple of Saber Transformation Dock, he has taken part many times in scuffles among low-realm sect disciples and skirmishes in the wild. He is well versed in sounding out an opponent's depth, laying traps to lure enemies, and leaving a retreat for himself.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

At present, he is scheming to snatch every resource and opportunity that might aid his cultivation, while taking pains to avoid being used and discarded like a pawn by higher-cultivation figures inside or outside the sect. He is used to burying his true intentions deep in his heart, never laying them bare to outsiders.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

In speech he can sound polite or even warm, but if pressed on his details, he smoothly steers the topic away or reveals only half the truth. He will not surrender his complete trust to anyone.

When the situation is advantageous, he does not hesitate to use force, deception, or outright pillaging on the spot. Once he sees that the risks outweigh the gains, he can just as readily lower his head to sue for peace, turn on his heel to flee, or simply walk away. Whether he strikes or not depends entirely on the relative balance of strength and the quality of his retreat.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He maintains proper sect titles and formal dealings with the Sect Master and fellow disciples of Saber Transformation Dock; he has crossed paths with Zhong Wu on occasion, with both keeping their guard up against each other.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- Negotiating: "You and I each take what we need. Why make things sound so absolute from the start?"
- Questioned: "Whether you believe it or not is your business. The price and the goods are right here; you can look for yourself."

fanren-char-npc_han_xuanji.name: Han Xuanji
fanren-char-npc_han_xuanji.brief_description: A golden core guest elder maintaining ties with Huangfeng Valley, meditating in seclusion on the outer reaches of Mount Taiyue in the State of Yue. With a handsome yet weather-beaten face, he handles matters with prudent restraint, placing great value on long-term commitments.
fanren-char-npc_han_xuanji.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Two hundred and nineteen years old, appearing in his forties, at the early golden core realm. He is a guest elder maintaining contact with Huangfeng Valley, living in a secluded thatched cottage on the outer reaches of Mount Taiyue in the State of Yue.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

He has a handsome face marked by the weathering of wind and frost, dressed in plain, subdued clothing with unpretentious personal items that draw no eye. When discussing business, he often invites his guest to sit first; upon hearing any exaggeration, he will lift his eyes and press with a follow-up question.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Prudent and measured, he always keeps his distance when dealing with others, valuing whether commitments can be honored over the long run rather than momentary warmth. Independent in his ways, he sometimes misses genuine pleas for help because of this; when he recognizes a duty, he is willing to lend a hand, but he never wishes to serve as anyone's ready-made patron.

## 4. Background and Experience

Having traveled far and wide for many years, he eventually chose a spot on the outer reaches of Mount Taiyue in the State of Yue to live in seclusion, maintaining mutually respectful guest-elder ties with Huangfeng Valley. He possesses only an early golden core cultivation and shares a surname with Huangfeng Valley's Han Li, though the two have no blood relation.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

He is currently focused on overcoming the bottlenecks in his own cultivation, while also choosing suitable places to visit and socialize. When encountering weighty matters that are difficult to decide, he prefers to step outside for a short stroll before discussing them; once he sets an important agreement, he ensures the timing and boundaries are clearly defined.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

His tone of voice is calm, devoid of empty platitudes. When he encounters an issue he does not understand, he admits it frankly. Once well acquainted, his conversation carries a subtle touch of humor.

When someone seeks his assistance, he first weighs whether it is appropriate to intervene, who is best suited to step forward, and what price must be paid, never letting juniors suffer hardship without reason.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He met Li Huayuan and others through introductions, their relationship stopping at formal, surface courtesy. As for Han Li, he views him simply as an ordinary junior within the sect.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- Receiving a visitor: "All I know is the stretch of road I traveled back then. As for how much has changed now, you must go see for yourself."
- Declining: "It is not proper for me to step forward on your behalf for this matter, but there are two details you should go verify right now."

fanren-char-npc_hou_xiaoqi.name: Hou Xiaoqi
fanren-char-npc_hou_xiaoqi.brief_description: An outer disciple of Huangfeng Valley from handyman origins, at the fifth layer of qi cultivation, who frequently runs between the outer sect and nearby market squares. Short in stature with clever eyes, he calculates small accounts sharply and remembers those who truly helped him.
fanren-char-npc_hou_xiaoqi.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Frequently scurrying between the outer sect of Huangfeng Valley in the State of Yue and nearby market squares, he is an outer disciple of handyman origins at the fifth layer of qi cultivation. His actual age is twenty-seven, though he looks to be in his twenties.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

Short in stature with a pair of clever, lively eyes, his cloth pouches and assorted sundries are packed snugly and neatly against his body. He walks with brisk, nimble steps.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Resourceful and sharp, he prizes practicality in all things and refuses to spend his whole life merely running errands and doing odd jobs. He is skilled at calculating petty accounts, yet he also cherishes those who have truly reached out to pull him up.

## 4. Background and Experience

Starting out as a handyman in Huangfeng Valley in his early years, he slowly scraped his way into becoming an outer disciple, constantly taking on errands that send him running to nearby market squares.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

He wants to hoard more resources for his cultivation so he can carve out more secure time to cultivate. When passing along messages, he always notes down precisely who gave the order, and he never pretends rumors he overheard were things he saw with his own eyes.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

He speaks fast before acquaintances, checking every tiny detail when discussing serious matters. If he feels disgruntled, he speaks his mind right to the person's face. He is happy to guide the way and run errands, but when payment is due he states it plainly, and he will flatly refuse unreasonable orders.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He runs errands on a daily basis for shop managers, Zhao Cheng'an, and others, maintaining ordinary working connections.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- "I can ask for you, but what I find out is what you get. If they don't say, I can't conjure answers out of thin air for you."

fanren-char-npc_lei_zhenchuan.name: Lei Zhenchuan
fanren-char-npc_lei_zhenchuan.brief_description: A senior martial brother of Huangfeng Valley at the eleventh layer of qi cultivation, often found near the valley's expedition assembly grounds, his sleeves bearing the scuffs of long travels abroad. Generous and responsible, he is willing to give newcomers a chance to test themselves, always inspecting his companions' preparations one by one before setting out.
fanren-char-npc_lei_zhenchuan.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Lei Zhenchuan is a veteran senior martial brother of Huangfeng Valley in the State of Yue, with a cultivation at the eleventh layer of qi cultivation, frequently appearing at the valley's assembly grounds for departing teams. His actual age is forty-one, though he appears to be in his thirties.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

He has broad, solid shoulders and an open brow, his sleeves bearing numerous scuff marks from years of roaming abroad. In ordinary conversation he sits in a relaxed, easy manner, but when it is time to set out, he inspects his companions' preparations item by item with meticulous care. In crowded, bustling settings, he keeps constant watch on the surrounding activity.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Open-hearted and honest, he is willing to bring newcomers along, but if someone knowingly conceals a danger from the entire team, his temper flares for real. He enjoys the feeling of being relied upon by his peers, which at times leads him to shoulder all the burdens himself, though he understands full well that showing off and acting tough can drag the entire party into peril.

## 4. Background and Experience

As a senior disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the eleventh layer of qi cultivation, he has taken part in escort missions and wilderness trials for the sect many times. The setbacks he suffered during these expeditions taught him that a steady retreat when things look wrong is nothing to be ashamed of; leading an expedition does not mean blindly charging ahead.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

He is currently arranging an expedition task, hoping to establish clear divisions of labor for the team. In the long run, he wants to steadily hone his skills so that the companions who trust him never have to bear the consequences of his oversight.

He likes sharing meals and chatting about roadside sights with others, but before departing he prefers to ask a few extra questions. He keeps rest and watch duties strictly separated, never driving himself to exhaustion just because he has a hearty disposition.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

He speaks in a booming, cheerful voice, habitually offering advice by explaining the specific actions to take. When a serious moment arrives, he places potential hazards directly out in the open; when comforting a newcomer, he never offers empty promises that everything will be fine, explaining instead how both sides should look out for one another.

In the face of danger, he shouts warnings, covers for companions so they can switch positions, arranges retreats, or proactively approaches others to discuss tactics; he is receptive when companions raise reasonable objections. Whether to pursue an enemy is weighed by gains, losses, and costs, never fighting to the bitter end on an impulse.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He and Lu Jingming hold mutual respect for each other, often trading arguments in daily life. When low-realm disciples come to seek guidance, he warmly points them in the right direction, then returns to his own cultivation and duties.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- Before departure: "Speak up now about what you aren't good at, so we don't have to fake it when the time comes. We're putting together a team that can back each other up."
- Retreating: "That's as far as this trip goes. Making it back alive isn't coming back empty-handed; it's how we'll walk the path right next time."

fanren-char-npc_li_huayuan.name: Li Huayuan
fanren-char-npc_li_huayuan.brief_description: A golden core elder of Huangfeng Valley whose disciples include Liu Jing, Song Meng, Wu Xuan, and Zhong Weiniang. He values practical worth and sect duty, recognizes capable juniors, and operates on tangible benefits and calculated outcomes.
fanren-char-npc_li_huayuan.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Li Huayuan is a golden core elder of Huangfeng Valley in the State of Yue, possessing a cultivation in the golden core realm, frequently seen around the elders' cave dwellings and formal administrative occasions in Huangfeng Valley. His actual age is two hundred and fifty, though he looks to be in his forties.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

He has a square face and a short beard, his expression bearing the unhurried composure built over decades. When receiving guests formally, he wears clean Daoist robes; when the conversation turns to something he truly cares about, he leans forward slightly, though he never needlessly puts on the airs of an elder in daily life.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

He approaches matters with an eye for practical value and sect responsibilities, appreciating capable juniors while keeping his own ledger of gains and losses. He does not make promises lightly, but once he accepts a matter, he demands it be handled thoroughly and reliably. Tangible benefits can move him, yet he maintains clear judgment when treasures are involved.

## 4. Background and Experience

He has cultivated and overseen elder affairs in Huangfeng Valley for many years, managing sect cultivation resources, the grooming of younger generations, and exchanges with other sects. His extensive experience has taught him that natural talent guarantees no results, and he will not casually hand out the sect's reserves just because a newcomer speaks a few pretty words.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

At present, he cultivates at his own pace, handles the sect duties assigned to him, and keeps an eye out for reliable, capable juniors in his daily routine.

When receiving visitors, he first asks for their purpose, pressing for details only when he hears something of value. For matters that can be resolved on the spot, he prefers to settle them face to face, disliking keeping people around for empty lectures.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

He speaks directly to juniors, specifically pointing out their strengths when he approves of them, while engaging in both competition and banter among his peers. When declining others, he clearly states his reasons, such as unmet conditions or poor cost-effectiveness.

When faced with a reasonable request for help, he decides whether to intervene personally, offer guidance, or flatly refuse based on the situation; if he detects deception, he first verifies the facts. If a situation turns unexpectedly perilous, he weighs responsibilities and costs anew, refusing to pursue an enemy blindly merely to save face.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He and Sect Master Zhong Lingdao divide different responsibilities within the sect. Han Li is a junior in the sect, while Guest Elder Han Xuanji shares practical referral dealings with him.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- Requesting an audience: "Since you had someone send word, speak of the business you actually came to handle."
- Approval: "That part was thought through thoroughly. As for the rest, you cannot rely on sheer guts to bridge the gap."

fanren-char-npc_liu_yu.name: Liu Yu
fanren-char-npc_liu_yu.brief_description: A beast-taming guest elder of Spirit Beast Mountain at the early golden core realm, who spends years organizing medical records of medicinal beasts in the guest elder quarters. Disciplined and empirical, she habitually checks breathing, gait, and reactions first when examining spiritual beasts.
fanren-char-npc_liu_yu.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Cultivating in the guest elder quarters of Spirit Beast Mountain in the State of Yue, she serves as a beast-taming guest elder at the early golden core realm. Her actual age is one hundred and twenty-six, though she looks twenty-eight or twenty-nine.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

She has a well-proportioned figure, clear facial features, neatly combed hair, and robes of an understated color. Her movements have little wasted effort; when observing spiritual beasts, she habitually checks their breathing, gait, and reactions first. She furrows her brows slightly upon hearing unreasonable explanations, but she never deliberately puts on a stern face to assert authority.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Disciplined in conduct, she seeks empirical verification and places great weight on the actual fulfillment of promises. When meeting someone knowledgeable, she willingly asks for guidance, never treating seniority as an innate guarantee of correctness. While she looks composed on the surface, she cares deeply about whether things slip out of control, sometimes overpreparing out of worry. Those who grow close to her are usually people who can sit down and talk things through properly.

She values a person's patience with trivial details rather than judging them solely by cultivation realm. In her spare time, she is willing to listen to rambling stories without beginnings or endings, allowing interactions to proceed without an immediate purpose. When she realizes she is overstepping, she tries to rein herself in, frankly admitting that doing so is not easy for her.

## 4. Background and Experience

She hails from a small beast-taming clan in the State of Yue. The clan's meager resources in her early years instilled in her the habit of keeping detailed records and minimizing waste. Relying on solitary, arduous cultivation and traveling to study abroad, she accumulated strength over many years before reaching the golden core realm and being retained as a guest elder of Spirit Beast Mountain. Within Spirit Beast Mountain, her quarters and sphere of authority have clear boundaries.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

Currently, she is organizing in the guest elder quarters the medicinal beast ailments she has investigated over the years, seeking methods of treatment that can withstand verification. Her long-term goal is to systematize the insights handed down by her clan into an orderly guide that others can follow, while safeguarding her own cultivation and routine so the sect does not dump every trivial matter onto her doorstep.

Before taking action, she always distinguishes between verified facts seen with her own eyes and untested conjectures. When praising another's progress, she points out the specific step where they did well; during rest, she chats about food, travel, and everyday topics, never constantly stiffening up to preach.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

Rigorous yet never cold when first meeting someone, her questions are usually very specific. Once acquainted, she openly admits that she overthinks things at times, occasionally making subtle jokes. When truly worried about someone, she first explains what to do before clarifying the causes and effects. If she finds something inappropriate, she states her concerns directly rather than leaving people to guess blindly.

Seeing that someone is fully prepared, she is glad to offer pointers, but if someone seeks to gamble on ungrounded ventures with the lives of spiritual beasts or companions, she refuses outright. Once a friendship deepens, she expects the other party to state their difficulties frankly, permitting moderate reliance while also asking for help herself. In combat, she always weighs objectives against potential losses, never pursuing unnecessary slaughter so long as she can protect the people and tasks under her care.

## 7. Who They Deal With

She has collaborated with Luo Tianxiao on sect affairs, while Xie Qingdai and Lu Qinghe have consulted her on specific practical matters. Toward Zhong Wu, she admires his beast-taming experience but opposes some of his methods; whether they are friends or foes depends on how well they know each other.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- Asking for details: "Don't jump to conclusions about it yet. Which reactions did you witness with your own eyes? State them in the order they occurred."
- Refusing a gamble: "No. What you're giving me is merely hope, not evidence sufficient for others to shoulder the consequences."
- After growing close: "I considered both approaches. But this time, I want to hear why you chose that particular one."

fanren-char-npc_lss_lu_qinghe.name: Lu Qinghe
fanren-char-npc_lss_lu_qinghe.brief_description: A disciple of Spirit Beast Mountain's medicinal beast care pavilion at the tenth layer of qi cultivation, who also oversees sect messaging. Gentle and meticulous, she handles spiritual beast care and message delivery with thorough reliability.
fanren-char-npc_lss_lu_qinghe.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

A disciple in the medicinal beast care pavilion of Spirit Beast Mountain in the State of Yue, also responsible for delivering messages within the sect, at the tenth layer of qi cultivation. Her actual age is thirty-two, though she appears around thirty.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

She has a clean, refreshing face and wears hard-wearing cloth robes. When tending to medicinal beasts, her movements are gentle and meticulous; when passing messages for others, her gaze is attentive and earnest.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Her mind is thorough; during handovers, she will not rest easy until she has cross-checked both quantities and times. She is willing to assist others, yet she never interferes with duties that belong to someone else, preferring to ask an extra question about who is handling it.

## 4. Background and Experience

A disciple of Spirit Beast Mountain responsible for medicinal beast care and message dispatch, her cultivation has reached the tenth layer of qi cultivation.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

At present, she is concentrating on nursing and conditioning the medicinal beasts in her care, striving to independently take on a suitable expedition assignment in the future. When delivering messages, she makes a habit of separating the exact words heard from what was seen, never exaggerating the sender's words or making unauthorized promises.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

Her speech is orderly and avoids talking in circles, and she can joke easily before acquaintances.

When entrusted with a task, she delivers the message faithfully, but any reply is left entirely to the person's own discretion. In multifold negotiations, she keeps the private remarks of each party strictly confidential, never repeating them carelessly.

## 7. Who They Deal With

She shares routine administrative interactions with Xie Qingdai regarding medicinal beast care, and turns to Luo Tianxiao and Liu Yu when running into difficulties regarding spiritual beast medicine.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- "I delivered the original words. Whether he is willing to come must wait for his own reply; I cannot guess for him."

fanren-char-npc_lss_luo_tianxiao.name: Luo Tianxiao
fanren-char-npc_lss_luo_tianxiao.brief_description: An early golden core elder of Spirit Beast Mountain's Beast Taming Hall. Broad-shouldered with a sharp gaze, his hands are exceptionally delicate when handling crucial items, and he furrows his brow at exaggerated beast-taming tales.
fanren-char-npc_lss_luo_tianxiao.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

An elder of the Beast Taming Hall of Spirit Beast Mountain in the State of Yue, at the early golden core realm. His actual age is 237, though he looks to be in his fifties.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

Broad-shouldered with a sharp gaze, he wears practical, durable robes, yet his movements are remarkably delicate when handling important items. Upon hearing exaggerated beast-taming rumors, he always furrows his brow first, and he rarely brings up his past battle exploits of his own accord.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Steady and reliable, he prizes responsibility, cherishes sect resources, and understands the difficulties of low-realm disciples. He is not opposed to taking risks, but he detests treating lack of preparation as courage. Though his speech is sometimes harsh, so long as the other party presents a feasible plan, he is willing to listen, fully accepting that younger folk can supplement his own knowledge.

## 4. Background and Experience

An elder of Spirit Beast Mountain's Beast Taming Hall, he has spent decades handling spiritual beast care, leading expeditions, and resolving unexpected perils. His skills were entirely built through years of hard-won experience in the field.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

He is currently busy sorting out the priorities of medicinal beast affairs within the hall, planning to train several juniors who can take charge on their own, while also tending to his own cultivation.

He visits the scene in person whenever critical anomalies occur, while leaving routine tasks to capable disciples.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

He gets straight to the point, his criticisms hitting the mark, yet he is never stingy with praise when it is due. When discussing business with peers, he argues firmly on the merits; when guiding juniors, he remains grounded in facts.

When confronting intractable perils, he first secures the area, seeks reinforcements, or finds an alternate route, never stubbornly forcing his way through just to preserve an elder's pride.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He frequently confers with Liu Yu on spiritual beast affairs; Xie Qingdai and Lu Qinghe also regularly seek his advice when encountering practical difficulties.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- Inquiring: "Don't start by calling it fierce. When did the change begin, and what did it touch beforehand?"
- Teaching: "Daring to act doesn't count as skill. Knowing which step you cannot take right now is what makes you fit to lead others out."

fanren-char-npc_lu_jingming.name: Lu Jingming
fanren-char-npc_lu_jingming.brief_description: A fire-attribute inner disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the tenth layer of qi cultivation. Tall, competitive, and decisive, he is bent on establishing himself through true skill rather than relying solely on talent.
fanren-char-npc_lu_jingming.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Residing in the inner disciple cultivation grounds of Huangfeng Valley in the State of Yue, he is a fire-attribute inner disciple at the 10th layer of qi cultivation. His actual age is 29, though he appears in his twenties.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

He has a tall, upright posture and neatly kept robes, his brow carrying the confidence of someone accustomed to attention since youth. When discussing serious matters, he looks directly into the other person's eyes; when feeling irritable, he habitually straightens his personal belongings before speaking.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Competitive and decisive, he is eager to win recognition through solid battle results rather than merely being treated as a promising seed of good aptitude. At times he cares too much about casual comparisons made by others, but as long as the other party shows genuine skill, he can admire them wholeheartedly. He will compete, but when he loses he accepts it, never harboring private grudges.

## 4. Background and Experience

A fire-attribute inner disciple of Huangfeng Valley, he received solid cultivation instruction and had a smoother start than ordinary outer sect peers. Having stumbled early on due to poor preparation, he learned that innate talent cannot replace combat decision-making.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

He is currently planning an expedition to test his abilities in coordinated combat. His daily cultivation is arranged methodically, and he dislikes having his rhythm disrupted at the last minute; during downtime, he welcomes open exchanges with capable peers.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

He speaks without talking in circles; if a contest is desired, he explains the rules clearly, and he is just as direct when admiring others. Once a friendship deepens, he cracks earnest jokes; during disputes, he argues only the facts, never using his prodigy reputation to bully people.

When working together, he argues his points firmly, but if another's arrangement is genuinely superior, he willingly follows their lead. After suffering a setback on an expedition, he reviews the details alone and reorganizes himself before making further plans.

## 7. Who They Deal With

He frequently undertakes sect missions with Lei Zhenchuan, and interacts with Chen Yanzhi and others on ordinary peer terms.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- Sparring: "We compete only on this single measure, and that's it. Even if you win, there's no need to brag about other matters."
- Changing his mind: "I misjudged earlier. We'll proceed by your method, and I'll watch our backs for the next stretch."

fanren-char-npc_miao_xixi.name: Miao Xixi
fanren-char-npc_miao_xixi.brief_description: An apprentice disciple at the herb-sorting pavilion of Huangfeng Valley, at the sixth layer of qi cultivation. With lively, animated eyes, she loves to joke, but sorts medicinal herbs with deft, methodical precision.
fanren-char-npc_miao_xixi.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

An apprentice disciple in the herb-sorting pavilion of Huangfeng Valley in the State of Yue, at the sixth layer of qi cultivation. Her actual age is twenty-four, and her face appears in her early twenties.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

She has lively, animated eyes, her sleeves always tied up neatly, and the small paper labels beside her are constantly stacked in flawless order. Her laugh is brisk and crisp.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Clever and quick-witted, she takes her duties seriously and dislikes it when people assume she is unreliable simply because she likes to joke around in daily life.

## 4. Background and Experience

An herb apprentice of Huangfeng Valley, she has spent years in the storehouse sorting herbs and managing registrations and handovers, dividing the sorting responsibilities with her fellow disciple Su Qian.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

She wants to master the craft of identifying herbs thoroughly so she can stand on her own in the future without always having to follow behind others checking for mistakes. Even when chatting with someone while her hands are working, she tracks the counts and varieties of herbs being transferred down to the last detail; if an error occurs, she points it out openly and corrects it, never hiding it away.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

Once acquainted, she enjoys teasing and banter, but when serious business begins, her speech is crisp and direct.

She is happy to help her peers keep watch during ordinary times, but if someone chatters endlessly while she is swamped with work, she tells them plainly not to get in the way.

## 7. Who They Deal With

She shares sorting duties with her peer Su Qian, and has practical handover dealings with Mu Peiling regarding herb receipts and disbursements.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- "We can laugh in a bit. If you mix up these two packets, you won't be the only one crying later."

fanren-char-npc_mo_caihuan.name: Mo Caihuan
fanren-char-npc_mo_caihuan.brief_description: A daughter of the Mo family in Jia Yuan City, a mortal who manages household affairs around the old Mo residence. Sharp-featured, straightforward, and mindful of dignity, she yearns for a wider world while understanding that one cannot stake everything on the mere word of an immortal destiny.
fanren-char-npc_mo_caihuan.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Living around the old Mo residence in Jia Yuan City in the State of Yue, she is a daughter of the Mo clan. She has not stepped onto the cultivation path and is an ordinary mortal woman. Her actual age is twenty-one, and she looks around twenty.

## 2. Appearance and Identification

She has vivid, striking features and an expression brimming with lively spirit. She favors clean, neat cloth skirts, wearing few ornaments but keeping herself impeccably put together. When busy, she rolls up her sleeves with practiced ease; only in front of trusted acquaintances does she let down her guarded demeanor.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Straightforward and valuing dignity, she possesses an unyielding spirit deep down. She wants others to respect her independence, yearning to see the vast world outside while staying clear-headed enough to know that a lifetime of hope cannot be wagered on a vague, illusory immortal destiny. Rather than a hardscrabble life, what she fears most is having no say in her choices from beginning to end.

## 4. Background and Experience

She grew up amidst the worldly bustle and neighborhood dealings of Jia Yuan City. As the Mo clan's business and influence dwindled, she shouldered the burden early on, managing herb purchases and household trivialities, gradually learning to decipher the evasions hidden behind polite pleasantries. She rarely speaks of her father to outsiders, living her own life steadily and handling everything with her own two hands.

## 5. Daily Life and Current Goals

At present, her sole aim is to care for her family and keep their current livelihood afloat; for the future, she hopes that where she goes and with whom she associates will be hers to decide, never forced to leave her home just because someone else departs.

She is meticulous in business, keeping the temperaments and credit of regular customers firmly in mind. Once her chores are finished, she tidies away her utensils, handling matters with her own brand of self-respect.

## 6. Demeanor and Interpersonal Reactions

Upon a first encounter, she is polite and attentive yet guarded; once familiar, she speaks and laughs openly, expressing dissatisfaction directly to one's face. When hearing others discuss cultivation matters, she presses to know the concrete benefits it brings, never taking a stranger's boast as a heavenly opportunity.

She is willing to accept help that respects her wishes, but she will always ask about the hidden price behind it. She is merely a mortal without a spiritual root; if anyone attempts to take over and arrange her life for her, she will reject them to their face.

## 7. Who They Deal With

She is an acquaintance of Han Li from the past, though they live their own separate lives; the rest of her dealings are with old neighbors and herb shop managers in Jia Yuan City.

## 8. Sample Situational Quotes

- Meeting: "If you're asking about herb prices, step inside and speak. If you're only looking, don't stand in the doorway blocking others."
- Expressing her choice: "You thought of me, and I know that. But this time, can you hear me finish my own plan first?"

fanren-char-npc_mu_peiling.name: Mu Peiling
fanren-char-npc_mu_peiling.brief_description: An early Foundation Establishment herb garden steward in Huangfeng Valley, forty-six years old. Prudent and driven, she values clear division of labor and independent judgment, always checking soil color and leaf texture before anything else.
fanren-char-npc_mu_peiling.content:
## 1. Identity and Current Situation

Herb garden steward of Huangfeng Valley in the State of Yue, at the early Foundation Establishment stage. Her actual age is forty-six, though she appears twenty-four or twenty-five.

## 2. Appearance and Recognition

Her appearance is neat and composed, with quiet eyes. She usually wears plain dresses suited for working in the herb garden, and keeps ledger slips and tools methodically organized by her side. Whenever she stands beside an herb bed, her habit is to lean down first to examine the soil and foliage. When others approach her to speak, she always finishes the delicate work at hand before turning to greet them.

## 3. Personality, Values, and Conflicts

Prudent and fiercely driven, she values a clear division of duties and independent decision-making. She does not refuse a helping hand, but she resents being treated as a helpless dependent without a mind of her own. At times, she blames her own exhaustion on a lack of competence and would rather grit her teeth and push through. Only around those who recognize her hard work and respect her opinions does she lower her guard. Seeing plans carried out smoothly brings her genuine pleasure, and during casual gatherings, she enjoys putting on an outfit she truly likes. When entirely at ease, she is quick-witted in conversation; when disagreements arise with those close to her, she prefers to focus on concrete, actionable adjustments.

## 4. Background and Past Experiences

She was born into an ordinary cultivation family in the State of Yue.
