The market outskirts provide lodging, rest stops and contact with herb gatherers. Paths and water levels affect travel. Water marks, sealed bottles and actual handlers offer better evidence than confident speculation.

An old herb cave may be observed, discussed or explored. Its interior becomes known through discovery, and reports may disagree. Removed objects and changed mechanisms do not reset the next day.
keywords: Market outskirts and the stream road

fanren-guide-place-gates.name: Sect entrances and seeking an audience
fanren-guide-place-gates.brief_description: A public sect entrance is where visitors explain their business, not the inevitable starting point for every loose cultivator. Markets or suitable lodgings fit independent travelers; sect and clan members may begin in their own everyday surroundings.
fanren-guide-place-gates.content:
A public sect entrance is where visitors explain their business, not the inevitable starting point for every loose cultivator. Markets or suitable lodgings fit independent travelers; sect and clan members may begin in their own everyday surroundings.

Gatekeepers consider real relationships, standing and purpose. An introduction may secure a message, while waiting, refusal or another visit can have ordinary consequences. A request need not provoke universal hostility, and a title does not open every restricted place.
keywords: Sect entrances and seeking an audience

fanren-guide-life-loose-cultivator.name: A loose cultivator’s home and friends
fanren-guide-life-loose-cultivator.brief_description: An independent cultivator lacks a sect’s regular support, but is not automatically penniless, friendless or indebted. Established possessions, skills, friendships and background provide a foundation.
fanren-guide-life-loose-cultivator.content:
An independent cultivator lacks a sect’s regular support, but is not automatically penniless, friendless or indebted. Established possessions, skills, friendships and background provide a foundation.

Lodging may be an affordable inn, a friend’s spare room or an established home. Days can include practice, work, errands or visits. Scarcity should have a specific cause, while prosperity should allow a more comfortable life.
keywords: A loose cultivator’s home and friends

fanren-guide-life-sect-disciple.name: An ordinary day as a sect disciple
fanren-guide-life-sect-disciple.brief_description: A disciple has peers, familiar places and routines. Practice, a specific lesson, tending herbs or visiting the market can fill a day without beginning with punishment or an examination.
fanren-guide-life-sect-disciple.content:
A disciple has peers, familiar places and routines. Practice, a specific lesson, tending herbs or visiting the market can fill a day without beginning with punishment or an examination.

A duty has a concrete purpose, recipient and timing, and can end once fulfilled. Instruction depends on the relationship and the method involved. The protagonist may work diligently, rest, decline extra requests or pursue another direction.
keywords: An ordinary day as a sect disciple

fanren-guide-life-privileged-heir.name: An influential beginning
fanren-guide-life-privileged-heir.brief_description: A distinguished heir or valued successor may truly possess the resources, status, home and support established at creation. Recognition and appropriate courtesy give that standing real weight. A story need not begin by stripping away possessions or killing the family.
fanren-guide-life-privileged-heir.content:
A distinguished heir or valued successor may truly possess the resources, status, home and support established at creation. Recognition and appropriate courtesy give that standing real weight. A story need not begin by stripping away possessions or killing the family.

There are still choices worth making: a craft to study, an invitation to answer, a journey to take or someone to support. Family backing does not make everyone a servant, nor must confidence provoke universal hostility. Challenges can match the character’s actual strength and position.

fanren-guide-mortal-towns.name: Mortal towns, villages and travel
fanren-guide-mortal-towns.brief_description: The landscape between cultivation sites is also home to farmers, boat crews, artisans, healers and shopkeepers. They have seasons, friends and concerns of their own, rather than existing only to be rescued or threatened.
fanren-guide-mortal-towns.content:
The landscape between cultivation sites is also home to farmers, boat crews, artisans, healers and shopkeepers. They have seasons, friends and concerns of their own, rather than existing only to be rescued or threatened.

Travelers may seek directions at an inn, wait for a boat or buy food. Local people may know roads and weather without understanding cultivation terms. Keeping a promise or paying fairly can explain a visitor’s intentions better than announcing a realm.

fanren-guide-mortal-family.name: Cultivators and mortal relatives
fanren-guide-mortal-family.brief_description: Cultivation does not automatically erase family ties. Relatives may be proud, worried or distant, or still see a returning traveler as their child. A reunion after a long absence acknowledges the years that really passed.
fanren-guide-mortal-family.content:
Cultivation does not automatically erase family ties. Relatives may be proud, worried or distant, or still see a returning traveler as their child. A reunion after a long absence acknowledges the years that really passed.

An errand, a sick visit, a farewell or a message can form a complete experience. Cultivation does not guarantee a cure for everything, and not every mortal seeks immortality. Care and closeness follow established relationships and individual wishes.

canon_chen_qiaoqian.name: Chen Qiaoqian
canon_chen_qiaoqian.brief: A disciple from the Chen clan at Huangfeng Valley at the twelfth layer of qi cultivation, whose elder brother Chen Qiaotian also belongs to the sect. Serious and proud, she conducts herself with care, determined to forge her own path of cultivation.

canon_chen_qiaotian.name: Chen Qiaotian
canon_chen_qiaotian.brief: A Huangfeng Valley cultivator from the Chen clan of Yue who has reached early foundation establishment, and elder brother to Chen Qiaoqian. He treasures his family and keeps his word, willing to win advantages for his juniors while knowing they must ultimately walk their own path.

canon_dong_xuaner.name: Dong Xuan'er
canon_dong_xuaner.brief: A female Huangfeng Valley disciple at the eleventh layer of qi cultivation who enjoys the protection of Elder Hongfu. Bright and attractive yet proud to a fault, she refuses to let others arrange her marriage or decide her future.

canon_fairy_nichang.name: Fairy Nichang
canon_fairy_nichang.role: Senior golden core cultivator and external envoy
canon_fairy_nichang.brief: A senior golden core cultivator of the Masked Moon Sect and one of its official representatives to the outside world. Calm and tactful in negotiation, she maintains the sect's dignity while remaining considerate of ordinary people's difficulties.

canon_feng_yue.name: Feng Yue
canon_feng_yue.brief: A Tianque Fort disciple at the twelfth layer of qi cultivation. Tempered by repeated low-level trials and skirmishes, he is forceful and blunt, adept at securing an escape route before bargaining.

canon_han_yunzhi.name: Han Yunzhi
canon_han_yunzhi.brief: A low-rank beast-taming disciple of Spirit Beast Mountain at the ninth layer of qi cultivation who studied among loose cultivators in her earlier years. Gentle and sincere, she hopes to earn a place in the sect by her own abilities.

canon_hong_fu.name: Hongfu
canon_hong_fu.brief: A golden core elder of Huangfeng Valley known for her resolute efficiency and protective loyalty toward her own. Assertive during sect councils, she shows special favor to her junior Dong Xuan'er.

canon_lei_wanhe.name: Lei Wanhe
canon_lei_wanhe.brief: A golden core elder of Huangfeng Valley who specializes in lightning arts. Affable on the surface and keen on practical benefits, he steps forward to investigate whatever genuinely interests him and is always willing to offer a trade.

canon_linghu.name: Ancestor Linghu
canon_linghu.brief: The sole nascent soul Grand Elder of Huangfeng Valley. Usually roaming abroad, he speaks with deliberate slowness when handing down judgments, measuring every decision against the long-term survival of the sect.

canon_liu_jing.name: Liu Jing
canon_liu_jing.brief: A disciple under the golden core cultivator Li Huayuan of Huangfeng Valley, currently at early foundation establishment. Upright and steadfast with a strong sense of duty, he takes on risks willingly while respecting the individual paths chosen by his fellow disciples.

canon_martial_ma.name: Martial Uncle Ma
canon_martial_ma.brief: A late Foundation Establishment cultivator in charge of Huangfeng Valley's Hundred Herb Garden. Short in stature with graying hair and beard, he spends his days tending spiritual herbs in the fields. Particular by nature and impatient with idle chatter, he is nonetheless willing to guide juniors who work with steady dedication.

canon_nie_ying.name: Nie Ying
canon_nie_ying.brief: A young female disciple at the tenth layer of Qi Cultivation in Huangfeng Valley. Born from an ordinary background, she is quiet, composed, and handles her duties with great tact and methodical care.

canon_qi_yunxiao.name: Qi Yunxiao
canon_qi_yunxiao.brief: A loose cultivator from the State of Yuanwu at the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation, skilled in crafting both artifacts and formations. His hands bear the marks of long practical work, and he speaks with far more energy about his trade than in polite pleasantries.

canon_qiong.name: Old Monster Qiong
canon_qiong.brief: A senior Golden Core cultivator of the Masked Moon Sect who wields a singular movement art. Indifferent to outward appearances, he possesses an exceptionally sharp gaze and loves probing others on the subtlest details they failed to notice.

canon_song_meng.name: Song Meng
canon_song_meng.brief: An early Foundation Establishment cultivator of Huangfeng Valley studying under Li Huayuan. Sturdily built and blunt in speech, he relishes a challenge and prizes loyalty among friends.

canon_wu_feng.name: Wu Feng
canon_wu_feng.brief: A technique-imparting disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the thirteenth layer of Qi Cultivation, tasked with instructing new disciples in their methods. Calm, thorough, and fond of weighing fine points, he moves through every task with unhurried ease.

canon_wu_xuan.name: Wu Xuan
canon_wu_xuan.brief: An early Foundation Establishment cultivator under Li Huayuan in Huangfeng Valley. Cautious and restrained, he guards his cultivation time strictly and accepts responsibility only for what he has clearly pledged to do.

canon_xiao_zhen.name: Xiao Zhen
canon_xiao_zhen.role: Elder to Xiao Cui'er, Low-Rank Loose Cultivator
canon_xiao_zhen.brief: A low-rank loose cultivator on the fringes of the State of Yue's capital, at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation. He and his granddaughter Xiao Cui'er rely on one another to survive. Devoted to family and habitually cautious, he values trustworthy channels and always inquires about a junior's motives before offering advice.

canon_xin_ruyin.name: Xin Ruyin
canon_xin_ruyin.brief: A female cultivator from the State of Yuanwu who has devoted herself to formations, currently at the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation. Elegant in manner and meticulous in thought, she associates with Qi Yunxiao as an intellectual peer.

canon_yan_ancestor.name: Yan Clan Ancestor
canon_yan_ancestor.brief: The Golden Core ruling ancestor of the Yan Clan in the State of Yue. Having presided over the clan's major affairs for years, he conducts business with seasoned caution, holding the clan's safety and survival above all else.

canon_yan_ruyan.name: Yan Ruyan
canon_yan_ruyan.brief: A young cultivator of the Yan Clan in the State of Yue upon whom high hopes are placed, at the twelfth layer of qi cultivation. Poised and dignified, she values autonomy and self-respect; while willing to shoulder clan responsibilities, she desires even more to control her own future.

canon_zhong_weiniang.name: Zhong Weiniang
canon_zhong_weiniang.brief: A young disciple under Li Huayuan of Huangfeng Valley, at the thirteenth layer of qi cultivation. Bright and vivacious, she wears her feelings openly and acts with sincerity and brisk efficiency.

leader_du_hanzhang.name: Du Hanzhang
leader_du_hanzhang.role: Sect Leader of the Masked Moon Sect
leader_du_hanzhang.brief: Sect Leader of the Masked Moon Sect, in the early golden core stage. Composed and resolute, handling sect rules and disciple circumstances with decisive clarity while respecting the autonomous choices of fellow sect members.

leader_gu_zheng.name: Gu Zheng
leader_gu_zheng.role: Sect Leader of the Giant Sword Sect
leader_gu_zheng.brief: Sect Leader of the Giant Sword Sect, in the late foundation establishment stage. Having spent years in basic training and external duties in his early days, he speaks bluntly and places immense value on keeping his word.

leader_lu_shouheng.name: Lu Shouheng
leader_lu_shouheng.brief: Sect Leader of Tianque Fortress, in the late foundation establishment stage. Having spent many of his earlier years on guard duty and escort missions, he is practical and steady, accustomed to listening to the real difficulties of frontline disciples.

leader_shen_lixing.name: Shen Lixing
leader_shen_lixing.role: Sect Leader of Saber Transformation Dock
leader_shen_lixing.brief: Sect Leader of Saber Transformation Dock, in the late foundation establishment stage. Sharp and decisive, he focuses on actionable, practical plans and insists on solid evidence rather than favoritism when resolving disciple disputes.

leader_wen_shouyi.name: Wen Shouyi
leader_wen_shouyi.role: Sect Leader of the Qingxu Sect
leader_wen_shouyi.brief: Sect Leader of the Qingxu Sect, in the late foundation establishment stage. He focuses on seeking truth from facts, listens attentively, and treats others with great patience.

leader_xu_chengyue.name: Xu Chengyue
leader_xu_chengyue.role: Sect Leader of Spirit Beast Mountain
leader_xu_chengyue.brief: Sect Leader of Spirit Beast Mountain, in the early golden core stage. Hailing from an ordinary cultivation family within the sect, he is steady, knows when to make concessions, and never speaks in an overbearing tone.

leader_zhong_lingdao.name: Zhong Lingdao
leader_zhong_lingdao.brief: Sect Leader of Huangfeng Valley, in the late foundation establishment stage, with the middle-aged appearance of a man sporting a three-strand beard. Steady in conduct, he excels at coordinating among diverse factions, striking a balance between sect rules and the counsel of senior elders.

npc_b_cj_tn_yaopu.name: Bai Zhu
npc_b_cj_tn_yaopu.brief: A resident physician at a clinic in the State of Yue market, at the ninth layer of qi cultivation. Gentle in demeanor, he keeps thorough case notes, handles external injuries with steady care, and speaks candidly when encountering illnesses beyond his certainty.

npc_b_fs_hf_zhanggui.name: Qian Shouxin
npc_b_fs_hf_zhanggui.brief: The shopkeeper of a pill shop in the State of Yue market, at the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation. His fingers are often seen running along inventory tags as he checks stock. Trustworthy and skilled with figures, he focuses on long-term business, describing new wares truthfully without exaggerating.
npc_b_fs_hf_zhanggui.initial_place_label: State of Yue Market Pill Shop

npc_b_fs_tn_tanzhu.name: Granny Wang
npc_b_fs_tn_tanzhu.brief: A talisman stallholder in the State of Yue market, at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation. Her wares are neatly stacked by intended use. Forthright and protective of her reputation, she budgets carefully and refuses to court trouble for petty gains.
npc_b_fs_tn_tanzhu.initial_place_label: State of Yue Market Talisman Stall

npc_b_zm_hfg_shoumen.name: Lu Shoushan
npc_b_zm_hfg_shoumen.brief: A gatekeeper disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation. Standing clear of the road, he inspects orders and tokens before letting anyone pass, having little patience for visitors who try to skip verification by throwing their weight around.

npc_b_zm_lss_shoumen.name: Huzi
npc_b_zm_lss_shoumen.brief: A mountain guard disciple of Spirit Beast Mountain at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation. Sturdily built and quick to move, he keeps a safe distance from spirit beasts while guarding the gate and handles his duties with brisk alertness.

npc_b_zm_yy_shoumen.name: Leng Shuang
npc_b_zm_yy_shoumen.brief: A mountain gate deacon of the Masked Moon Sect at early Foundation Establishment. Composed in appearance and consistently vigilant, she questions callers without being overbearing, mindful of proper boundaries between visitors and the sect.

npc_chen_yanzhi.name: Chen Yanzhi
npc_chen_yanzhi.brief: An outer disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation who lives in the valley's outer quarters. His robes are old but spotless. Level-headed and eager to help his peers, he dreads being a burden and never pretends to know what he does not.

npc_fan_jingmei.name: Fan Jingmei
npc_fan_jingmei.role: Independent Golden Core Cultivator Retained by a Merchant Guild
npc_fan_jingmei.brief: An independent Golden Core cultivator retained by a merchant guild. Tactful, clear-headed, and mindful of reputation, she excels at reducing heated disputes to practical issues that can be settled by negotiation.

npc_fu_yunzi.name: Fuyunzi
npc_fu_yunzi.brief: A Golden Core cultivator of the Qingxu Sect who often represents the sect at joint affairs of the seven sects. While his casual chatter appears carefree, his gaze fixes intently on the other party whenever terms are raised, monitoring every subtle reaction.
npc_fu_yunzi.initial_place_label: Qingxu Sect and Seven Sects Joint Affairs Site

npc_gu_xiaoman.name: Gu Xiaoman
npc_gu_xiaoman.role: Wandering Loose Cultivator from the State of Yue
npc_gu_xiaoman.brief: A wandering loose cultivator who travels between the western borders of the State of Yue and its various markets, at early Foundation Establishment. Straightforward, clever, and jealous of her freedom, she enjoys a lively gathering but remains exceedingly careful about lasting commitments.
npc_gu_xiaoman.initial_place_label: Western Border Loose Cultivator Settlement and Connecting Markets

npc_gui_wujiu.name: Gui Wujiu
npc_gui_wujiu.role: External Affairs Cultivator with Ghost Spirit Sect Background
npc_gui_wujiu.brief: An external affairs cultivator operating around border waystations for traveling merchants in the State of Yue, at mid Foundation Establishment. Sober in attire, he watches how callers address others and where they hail from, unconvinced that every dispute is worth risking one's life over.
npc_gui_wujiu.initial_place_label: State of Yue Border Waystation for Traveling Merchants

npc_han_li.name: Han Li
npc_han_li.brief: A newly admitted disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation, living in the novice quarters within the valley. Ordinary in appearance, he is cautious and pragmatic, always securing an escape route before weighing personal ties.

npc_han_tianya.name: Han Tianya
npc_han_tianya.brief: A disciple of Huadao Dock at the twelfth layer of Qi Cultivation who acts dangerously and excels at seizing openings. Polite and refined on the surface, he bares his true edge only when holding the upper hand.

npc_han_xuanji.name: Han Xuanji
npc_han_xuanji.role: Golden Core Guest Elder Associated with Huangfeng Valley
npc_han_xuanji.brief: A Golden Core guest elder who maintains ties with Huangfeng Valley, cultivating in seclusion on the outer slopes of Mount Taiyue in the State of Yue. He has a clean-cut, weathered demeanor, handles matters with caution and measured restraint, and values long-term commitments.
npc_han_xuanji.initial_place_label: Quiet Residence on the Outer Slopes of Taiyue, State of Yue

npc_hou_xiaoqi.name: Hou Xiaoqi
npc_hou_xiaoqi.role: Outer Disciple from a Servant Background
npc_hou_xiaoqi.brief: An outer disciple of Huangfeng Valley from a servant background at the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation, who frequently runs between the outer sect and the nearby market. Short of stature with lively eyes, he keeps clear accounts of minor debts and remembers those who have truly helped him.
npc_hou_xiaoqi.initial_place_label: Huangfeng Valley Outer Sect and Nearby Market

npc_lei_zhenchuan.name: Lei Zhenchuan
npc_lei_zhenchuan.brief: A senior brother of Huangfeng Valley at the eleventh layer of Qi Cultivation, often seen around the valley's assembly ground, his sleeves worn from years of travel. Forthright and responsible, he is willing to give newcomers a chance to gain experience, and always checks each companion's preparations before setting out.

npc_li_huayuan.name: Li Huayuan
npc_li_huayuan.brief: A Golden Core elder of Huangfeng Valley with disciples including Liu Jing, Song Meng, Wu Xuan, and Zhong Weiniang. He values practical worth and sect obligations, appreciates capable juniors, and conducts his affairs with an eye for tangible gains and losses.
npc_li_huayuan.initial_place_label: Huangfeng Valley Elder Cave Abode and Formal Affairs Venues

npc_liu_yu.name: Liu Yu
npc_liu_yu.brief: An early Golden Core beast-taming guest elder of Spirit Beast Mountain, who spends years organizing medicinal beast case files in the guest quarters. Disciplined and empirical, he habitually examines a spirit beast's breathing, gait, and responsiveness first.

npc_lss_lu_qinghe.name: Lu Qinghe
npc_lss_lu_qinghe.brief: A disciple at the tenth layer of Qi Cultivation stationed at Spirit Beast Mountain's medicinal beast care station, who also manages sect communications. Gentle and meticulous, she is thorough and dependable whether caring for spirit beasts or relaying messages.
npc_lss_lu_qinghe.initial_place_label: Spirit Beast Mountain Medicinal Beast Care Station

npc_lss_luo_tianxiao.name: Luo Tianxiao
npc_lss_luo_tianxiao.brief: An early Golden Core elder of Spirit Beast Mountain's Beast Taming Hall. Broad-shouldered with sharp eyes, his movements are exceedingly delicate when handling critical matters, and his brows furrow at exaggerated beast-taming rumors.
npc_lss_luo_tianxiao.initial_place_label: Spirit Beast Mountain Beast Taming Hall

npc_lu_jingming.name: Lu Jingming
npc_lu_jingming.brief: A fire-affinity inner disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the tenth layer of Qi Cultivation. Upright, competitive, and decisive in action, he is intent on making his mark through true skill rather than mere innate talent.
npc_lu_jingming.initial_place_label: Huangfeng Valley Inner Sect Cultivation Grounds

npc_miao_xixi.name: Miao Xixi
npc_miao_xixi.brief: An apprentice disciple at the Huangfeng Valley herb sorting office at the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation. Lively and spirited, she loves to joke around, yet sorts herbs with swift hands and methodical precision.

npc_mo_caihuan.name: Mo Caihuan
npc_mo_caihuan.role: Daughter of the Mortal Mo Family
npc_mo_caihuan.brief: A mortal daughter of the Mo family in Jiayuan City, managing household affairs around the old Mo residence. Sharp-featured, straightforward, and mindful of dignity, she yearns for a wider world while knowing better than to pin everything on a chance encounter with immortal destiny.
npc_mo_caihuan.initial_place_label: Vicinity of the Old Mo Residence in Jiayuan City

npc_mu_peiling.name: Mu Peiling
npc_mu_peiling.brief: A forty-six-year-old steward of the Huangfeng Valley herb garden at the early Foundation Establishment stage. Composed and strong-willed, she prizes clear division of labor and independent judgment, always inspecting the soil and leaves first whenever she stands by the herb beds.

npc_nan_gongwan.name: Nangong Wan
npc_nan_gongwan.role: Masked Moon Sect Core Formation Cultivator
npc_nan_gongwan.brief: A Core Formation cultivator of the Masked Moon Sect who travels between sect grounds and inter-sect affairs. With clear features and a sharp, composed demeanor, she resolves matters with crisp clarity rather than leaning on power to bully others.
npc_nan_gongwan.initial_place_label: Masked Moon Sect Cultivation Quarters and Inter-Sect Venues

npc_ning_fuling.name: Ning Fuling
npc_ning_fuling.brief: An independent medical cultivator at early Core Formation, practicing in the Western Border market of Yue. Composed and calm, she starts every consultation by pointing out practical steps that can be taken now, never brushing aside a patient's worries with a hollow platitude to just listen.

npc_pei_shixiong.name: Pei Shixiong
npc_pei_shixiong.role: External Affairs Cultivator with Independent Interests
npc_pei_shixiong.brief: An external affairs cultivator of Huangfeng Valley at early Foundation Establishment serving on external affairs missions. When hearing action plans, he checks prepared supplies before probing for oversights, acting with caution and caring deeply about division of responsibility.

npc_pei_yuanlang.name: Pei Yuanlang
npc_pei_yuanlang.brief: A Huangfeng Valley disciple from a cultivation family, currently at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation. Proud and conscious of face, he cares deeply about whether others recognize his genuine ability.

npc_qin_shouzheng.name: Qin Shouzheng
npc_qin_shouzheng.brief: A deacon of the Huangfeng Valley Law Enforcement Office at late Foundation Establishment. Lean and stern of face, he withholds judgment while listening to testimony, first determining whether the speaker witnessed the matter firsthand or merely passed along hearsay.

npc_qingxia_zhenren.name: Master Qingxia
npc_qingxia_zhenren.brief: A deacon of the Huangfeng Valley Pill Chamber at mid Foundation Establishment, overseeing her domain alongside the herb garden. Absorbed and meticulous when inspecting ingredients, she readily guides juniors willing to use their heads, but despises those who treat hearsay as a shortcut.

npc_shi_jian.name: Shi Jian
npc_shi_jian.brief: An outer disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation on duty at the outer sect reception post, having previously wandered as a loose cultivator in distant lands. Steady and reliable in word and deed, he resents being judged by his past origins.
npc_shi_jian.initial_place_label: Huangfeng Valley Outer Sect Reception Post

npc_shi_zhongjian.name: Shi Zhongjian
npc_shi_zhongjian.brief: An ascetic disciple in the Huangfeng Valley outer disciple cultivation area at the eighth level of qi cultivation. Sturdily built and taciturn, he tempers his foundation entirely through frugal living and relentless daily practice.
npc_shi_zhongjian.initial_place_label: Huangfeng Valley Outer Disciple Cultivation Area

npc_song_guanlan.name: Song Guanlan
npc_song_guanlan.brief: A disciple in the Huangfeng Valley Formation Affairs Study Office at the seventh level of qi cultivation, devoted to mastering formations. With ink-stained sleeves, earnest curiosity, and deep focus, he easily forgets everything else once engrossed in a diagram.
npc_song_guanlan.initial_place_label: Huangfeng Valley Formation Affairs Study Office

npc_song_hanyi.name: Song Hanyi
npc_song_hanyi.brief: A sword cultivator disciple of the Masked Moon Sect at the ninth level of qi cultivation, aged twenty-four, with thin calluses across her palms and fingers from sword practice. Restrained and dependable, she holds herself to stricter standards than anyone else and dislikes having a female cultivator's path made into casual gossip.

npc_song_yu.name: Song Yu
npc_song_yu.brief: A visiting guest elder invited to the Pure Void Sect for exchange, at early golden core and residing in the Guest Courtyard. Elegant and poised in manner, she values independence and self-reliance, pleased to guide juniors without ever making decisions for them.

npc_su_qian.name: Su Qian
npc_su_qian.brief: An alchemist disciple in the Huangfeng Valley Alchemy Chamber at the seventh level of qi cultivation. A faint scent of medicinal herbs lingers on her fingers. Gentle and meticulous by nature, she aims to stand on her own through solid skill rather than merely be someone who is agreeable.

npc_sun_shi.name: Madam Sun
npc_sun_shi.brief: An herb farmer in a mortal mountain town in the State of Yue, aged forty-three, who deals in the medicinal herb trade. Her hands bear the marks of hard labor. Industrious and decisive, she honors her word and never places blind trust in a cultivator's promises.
npc_sun_shi.initial_place_label: State of Yue Mountain Town Herb Garden

npc_tianque_tili_zhanglao.name: Fortress Defense Deacon
npc_tianque_tili_zhanglao.brief: A fortress defense deacon in the Tianque Fortress External Affairs Office at late foundation establishment, aged one hundred and fifty-six. Steady and focused on teamwork, he excels at organizing watches and escorts, always checking first to see who in a party is exhausted and who is carrying heavy loads.

npc_wang_shishu.name: Martial Uncle Wang
npc_wang_shishu.brief: A deacon at the Huangfeng Valley Registration and Reception Office at early foundation establishment. He flips through records briskly, his finger halting at any ambiguous entry. Though hardly mild-tempered, he never gives incoming disciples trouble without cause.
npc_wang_shishu.initial_place_label: Huangfeng Valley Registration and Reception Office

npc_wen_wenyan.name: Wen Wenyan
npc_wen_wenyan.brief: An outer disciple of Huangfeng Valley at the eighth level of qi cultivation, serving in the External Affairs Office. Often wearing a gentle smile, he handles affairs with propriety and order, valuing trust while navigating social subtleties with ease.

npc_wuming_jianke.name: Nameless Swordsman
npc_wuming_jianke.brief: A sword cultivator deacon of the Great Sword Sect at late foundation establishment, receiving guests at the External Affairs Office. Upright in posture and dressed in plain, clean robes, he speaks little but has a sharp, expressive demeanor, prizing action and results.
npc_wuming_jianke.initial_place_label: Great Sword Sect External Affairs Office

npc_xiao_cuier.name: Xiao Cui'er
npc_xiao_cuier.role: Junior Loose Cultivator Living with Elders
npc_xiao_cuier.brief: A junior loose cultivator at the third layer of Qi Cultivation living with an elder on the outskirts of Yuejing. Bright and eager to learn, she is quick-witted in unexpected situations and constantly driven to prove herself.
npc_xiao_cuier.initial_place_label: Loose Cultivator Dwellings on the Outskirts of Yuejing

npc_xie_qingdai.name: Xie Qingdai
npc_xie_qingdai.brief: A beast-taming disciple of Spirit Beast Mountain at the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation who always carries clean cloths. Attentive and gentle when observing creatures, she focuses closely on their actual physical condition.

npc_xue_ya.name: Xue Ya
npc_xue_ya.brief: A broker operating at the tenth layer of Qi Cultivation in a market connecting the State of Yue with outside regions. Unassumingly dressed and sparing in his movements when negotiating prices, he is bold enough to take high-risk deals, yet quick to withdraw the moment things turn south.
npc_xue_ya.initial_place_label: Cross-Border Market of the State of Yue

npc_yin_nishang.name: Yin Nishang
npc_yin_nishang.role: Wandering Female Cultivator with Ties to the Acacia Sect
npc_yin_nishang.brief: An early Golden Core female cultivator wandering abroad, residing in a quiet dwelling outside the market. Expressive and sharp-eyed, she despises being judged solely by the sect she came from.

npc_yinxi.name: Yinxi
npc_yinxi.brief: A zither cultivator of the Masked Moon Sect at the early Foundation Establishment stage, living in a quiet dwelling on the sect's outskirts. Elegant in demeanor and relaxed in posture, she keeps an ear to her surroundings while playing, always attentive to the unspoken reservations behind another person's words.
npc_yinxi.initial_place_label: Quiet Residence on the Outskirts of the Masked Moon Sect

npc_yy_gu_wanqing.name: Gu Wanqing
npc_yy_gu_wanqing.brief: A late Foundation Establishment vice deacon in the Masked Moon Sect's Law Enforcement Office. Guided by procedure and hard facts, she assesses the condition and injuries of all parties before acting, always measuring her conduct with care.
npc_yy_gu_wanqing.initial_place_label: Masked Moon Sect Law Enforcement Office

npc_yy_shen_ningxue.name: Shen Ningxue
npc_yy_shen_ningxue.brief: An early Foundation Establishment steward disciple of the Masked Moon Sect's herb garden. Quiet, neat, and composed, she works with meticulous care and never takes thoroughness for granted.

npc_zhang_laotou.name: Old Man Zhang
npc_zhang_laotou.role: Senior Disciple Reassigned to Reception After Old Injuries
npc_zhang_laotou.brief: An elderly receptionist at the Yellow Maple Valley mountain gate duty post, cultivated to the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation. Graying at the temples from an old injury, he is patient and duty-bound, always willing to offer a word of advice to the young disciples passing through.
npc_zhang_laotou.initial_place_label: Yellow Maple Valley Mountain Gate Duty Post

npc_zhao_chengan.name: Zhao Cheng'an
npc_zhao_chengan.brief: An early Foundation Establishment steward in Yellow Maple Valley's Outer Sect Affairs Office. Patient and steady, he always leaves space on his desk for visitors to set down scrolls and records, adhering strictly to rules while remaining open to sensible compromises.
npc_zhao_chengan.initial_place_label: Yellow Maple Valley Outer Sect Affairs Office

npc_zhao_ling.name: Zhao Ling
npc_zhao_ling.role: Novice Cultivator from a Loose Cultivator Family
npc_zhao_ling.brief: A novice cultivator at the first layer of Qi Cultivation from a loose cultivator family on the outskirts of the State of Yue market. Clear-eyed and careful, she repeatedly checks her belongings and diligently takes notes and asks questions whenever she encounters something unfamiliar.
npc_zhao_ling.initial_place_label: Loose Cultivator Home on the Outskirts of the State of Yue Market

npc_zhong_wu.name: Zhong Wu
npc_zhong_wu.brief: A beast-taming disciple of Spirit Beast Mountain at the twelfth layer of Qi Cultivation. Alert and calculating, he is pragmatic and fierce in his methods, always weighing risks, rewards, and avenues of retreat before striking.

parallel_chen_dingyue.name: Chen Dingyue
parallel_chen_dingyue.brief: A Grand Elder of Heavenly Imperial Fortress at the early Nascent Soul stage. Poised and unhurried, he lets visitors speak first; his conduct is steady, emphasizing long-term defense.

parallel_cheng_xingheng.name: Cheng Xingheng
parallel_cheng_xingheng.brief: Sect Leader of Heavenly Star Sect in Yuanwu, at the late Foundation Establishment stage. Meticulously groomed, he excels at managing internal and external relations, preferring to let guests settle in before turning to pressing matters.

parallel_gu_beiheng.name: Gu Beiheng
parallel_gu_beiheng.brief: A Grand Elder of Giant Sword Sect at the early Nascent Soul stage. Upright and brisk, he values tangible evidence and personal accountability, carrying himself with quiet restraint.

parallel_jiang_yunxiu.name: Jiang Yunxiu
parallel_jiang_yunxiu.role: Senior Elder, Locally Revered as Ancestor
parallel_jiang_yunxiu.brief: A senior elder of Yunxiu Sect in Zijin at the late Golden Core stage, locally addressed as Ancestor. Serene and dedicated to preserving the sect's heritage, she takes a practical approach and grants juniors ample freedom to shoulder their own duties.

parallel_jingheng.name: Daoist Jingheng
parallel_jingheng.brief: Sect Leader of Wanmiao Abbey in Yuanwu, at the late Foundation Establishment stage. Calm in demeanor and focused on what is feasible, he conscientiously oversees the abbey's routine affairs and outside ties.

parallel_lu_huaizhang.name: Lu Huaizhang
parallel_lu_huaizhang.role: Clan Head and External Affairs Director
parallel_lu_huaizhang.brief: Clan head and external affairs director of the Lu Clan of Zijin, a cultivator at the mid Foundation Establishment stage. Prudent and pragmatic, he values trust, looks after his kin, and places the clan's stability above all else.

parallel_lu_songnian.name: Lu Songnian
parallel_lu_songnian.brief: A senior elder of the Lu Clan of Zijin at the late Foundation Establishment stage. Gray-haired, mild-mannered, and dependable, he treasures the clan's heritage while warmly supporting younger kin who forge new paths.

parallel_may_yingqiu.name: Mei Yingqiu
parallel_may_yingqiu.brief: A Grand Elder of Moon Masking Sect at the mid Nascent Soul stage. Elegant and composed, she probes important matters in meticulous detail, keeping a watchful eye on long-term prospects and sectarian continuity.

parallel_shen_huaizhen.name: Shen Huaizhen
parallel_shen_huaizhen.brief: Sect Leader of Yunxiu Sect in Zijin, at the early Golden Core stage. Clean-cut and relaxed in manner, he treats juniors with generosity and warmth, proving himself a steady, principled leader.

parallel_shen_tianshu.name: Shen Tianshu
parallel_shen_tianshu.brief: Supreme Elder of the Heavenly Star Sect in Yuanwu Country, early Nascent Soul stage. Dressed simply, he values the long-term stability of the sect's heritage, probes details thoroughly, and rarely oversteps to make decisions for younger generations.

parallel_shen_xuanzhao.name: Shen Xuanzhao
parallel_shen_xuanzhao.brief: Supreme Elder of Saber Transformation Dock, early Nascent Soul stage. With a calm demeanor, he emphasizes action and practical responsibility, detests reckless advances, and stands ready to bear the consequences of his own decisions.

parallel_shen_zhaowei.name: Shen Zhaowei
parallel_shen_zhaowei.brief: An external affairs disciple of the Yunxiu Sect in Zijin Country, at the eighth layer of qi cultivation. Fresh-faced and spirited, he is intimately familiar with the routes he travels.

parallel_tao_lingjun.name: Tao Lingjun
parallel_tao_lingjun.brief: Supreme Elder of Spirit Beast Mountain, early Nascent Soul stage. Lean-faced and dignified in his modest conduct, he investigates even the faintest anomaly closely, overseeing the sect's larger affairs while always willing to listen to the specific hardships of its disciples.

parallel_tao_zhiyuan.name: Tao Zhiyuan
parallel_tao_zhiyuan.brief: Steward of the Heavenly Star Sect Market, middle Foundation Establishment stage. Plain of feature and neatly attired, he insists on thoroughly investigating the items and circumstances involved before settling any dispute.

parallel_wen_bailian.name: Wen Bailian
parallel_wen_bailian.brief: Supreme Elder of the Divine Weapon Sect in Yuanwu Country, an early Nascent Soul cultivator overseeing the higher-level heritage of artifact refinement. Deeply engrossed in studying artifacts, he values proven skill and practical innovations.

parallel_xu_xingzhou.name: Xu Xingzhou
parallel_xu_xingzhou.brief: A loose cultivator working as a traveling merchant and guide around Nanhe Market, at the tenth layer of qi cultivation. Cheerful and trustworthy, he has traveled his familiar routes for years and handles every matter with meticulous care.

parallel_xuanjing.name: Xuanjingzi
parallel_xuanjing.brief: Supreme Elder of the Qingxu Sect, early Nascent Soul stage. With neatly kept beard and hair and clear eyes, he is receptive to differing opinions and prioritizes tangible responsibility and enduring support.

parallel_xuanzhao.name: Xuanzhaozi
parallel_xuanzhao.brief: Supreme Elder of Myriad Wonders Abbey in Yuanwu Country, early Nascent Soul stage. He projects no intimidating pressure when receiving guests, champions independent judgment, and knows how to make necessary trade-offs.

parallel_yue_zhuchuan.name: Yue Zhuchuan
parallel_yue_zhuchuan.brief: Sect Leader of the Divine Weapon Sect in Yuanwu Country, late Foundation Establishment stage. Having risen from an ordinary disciple, he is pragmatic and trustworthy, his hands bearing the marks of years of practical labor.

parallel_zhou_shouan.name: Zhou Shou'an
parallel_zhou_shouan.brief: The steward of Nanhe Market and an early Foundation Establishment cultivator. Fair, pragmatic, and reliant on hard evidence, he resolves disputes and requests within the market swiftly without stalling.

npc_g11_duandao_ke.name: Waylayer
npc_g11_duandao_ke.brief: A fifth-layer Qi Cultivation loose cultivator who ambushes travelers along the dirt roads outside the market. Carrying a Water-Severing Saber wrapped in old cloth across his back, he preys on solitary low-tier cultivators, determined to hoard enough spirit stones to purchase his next cultivation method.

species_lingshoushan_qingfeng_que.name: Azure Wind Sparrow
species_lingshoushan_qingfeng_que.brief: A Tier 1 Azure Wind Sparrow housed in the beast pen beside the Spirit Beast Mountain medicinal garden, possessing cultivation at the first layer of Qi Cultivation.
species_lingshoushan_qingfeng_que.initial_place_label: Spirit Beast Mountain Herb-Beast Care Station

spirit_qiao_yan.name: Qiao Yan
spirit_qiao_yan.role: Keeper of the camp medicine stove
spirit_qiao_yan.brief: Keeper of the camp medicine stove. She pays for a genuine sample examination and wants to keep treasure disputes out of the camp. Before discussing her own origins, she notices whether a visitor respects privacy.

spirit_ruan_qingluo.name: Ruan Qingluo
spirit_ruan_qingluo.brief: Book-and-gear shopkeeper. She prefers customers to understand a tool before paying and checks where old books came from. She discusses arts without promising anyone an exclusive destiny.

spirit_lu_shiheng.name: Lu Shiheng
spirit_lu_shiheng.brief: Southern-market repairer. He values reproducible array traces and respects a choice to dismantle or preserve. He vouches only for what he has seen and does not command the city guard.

spirit_ning_shutong.name: Ning Shutong
spirit_ning_shutong.brief: Reader of old manuscripts. She does not treat every ancient sentence as a command. She compares readings and allows disagreement to remain open. She values friends' letters without deciding for distant people.

loose.name: Loose Cultivator
loose.description: Traveling Yue State with a worn cloth sack, scraping by on herb gathering, escorts, and odd jobs in the market. Nameless in mountain and wild, anywhere under heaven can be home.

sect.name: Sect Disciple
sect.description: An outer disciple of {affiliation}, balancing practice with everyday work. Beyond the gate, people and opportunities await your own choices.

family.name: Cultivation Family
family.description: Raised among the cultivation stories and practice yards of {affiliation}, now ready to choose a path beyond the family home.

custom.name: Custom background
custom.description: Write where you came from, who you are, and what brought you here.

clan-young-master.name: Great Clan Heir
clan-young-master.description: The recognized heir of your own cultivation clan, already at Foundation Establishment in your twenties. With 3,000 spirit stones and a family sword of your own, you begin at the clan estate, free to choose your first public undertaking.

fanren-foundation-escort.name: Foundation-stage wanderer
fanren-foundation-escort.description: An independent cultivator at Foundation Establishment, with six hundred spirit stones and medicine in a worn sack. A herb merchant has sent word about another mountain escort.

none.name: Unaligned (Loose Cultivator)
none.description: Belong to no sect or family.

own.name: Own Family
own.description: Establish a clan under your own surname, separate from the existing families of this world.

auto.name: Decide for Me
auto.description: Let the background draft assign a compatible affiliation within a normal range, without claiming high-tier factions.

auto.name: Decide for Me
auto.description: Let the background draft pick a starting location within the allowed living area of your chosen affiliation.

single.name: Single Spiritual Root
single.description: A spiritual root of only one element, giving a focused cultivation path.

dual.name: Dual Spiritual Roots
dual.description: Spiritual roots of two elements; you must decide for yourself where to make trade-offs.

triple.name: Triple Spiritual Roots
triple.description: Spiritual roots of three elements, common among loose cultivators.

quad.name: Four Spiritual Roots
quad.description: Spiritual roots of four elements, varied but unfocused.

quinary.name: Five Spiritual Roots
quinary.description: Possessing all five elements; slowest to cultivate, but least restricted.

pseudo.name: Pseudo Spiritual Root
pseudo.description: A mixed and impure foundation, barely cultivable.

waste.name: Waste Spiritual Root
waste.description: Almost unable to draw qi into the body; walking this path will be very slow.

wind.name: Wind Spiritual Root
wind.description: A mutated spiritual root. Agile and light, striking swiftly, adept at maneuvering with momentum.

thunder.name: Thunder Spiritual Root
thunder.description: A mutated spiritual root. Violent and fierce, unmatched at breaking barriers, but the hardest to control.

ice.name: Ice Spiritual Root
ice.description: A mutated spiritual root. Deep and chilling, with a tight and continuous defense that endures long battles.

poor.name: Poor
poor.description: Cultivation speed is about half that of an average person.

normal.name: Ordinary
normal.description: Ordinary aptitude, cultivating at normal speed.

good.name: Good
good.description: Cultivation speed is about 1.3 times that of an average person.

excellent.name: Excellent
excellent.description: Cultivation speed is about 1.6 times that of an average person.

exceptional.name: Exceptional
exceptional.description: Cultivation speed is about twice that of an average person.

sword.name: Sword
sword.description: Content tendency: greater chance of encountering sword-related opportunities in the story; does not grant advanced sword techniques.

blade.name: Saber
blade.description: Content tendency: greater chance of encountering saber-related opportunities in the story.

spear.name: Spear
spear.description: Content tendency: greater chance of encountering spear-related opportunities in the story.

fist.name: Unarmed
fist.description: Content tendency: greater chance of encountering unarmed combat opportunities in the story.

bow.name: Bow
bow.description: Content tendency: greater chance of encountering bow-related opportunities in the story.

talisman.name: Talisman
talisman.description: Content tendency: greater chance of encountering talisman-related opportunities in the story.

curious.name: Curious
curious.description: Always inclined to take a second look at unfamiliar things.

softhearted.name: Softhearted
softhearted.description: Cannot bear to see people suffer before your eyes.

taciturn.name: Taciturn
taciturn.description: A person of few words, accustomed to letting actions speak.

resentful.name: Grudge-bearing
resentful.description: Remembers both favors and grievances in clear detail.

strong_body.name: Robust Physique
strong_body.description: Sturdy bones and muscles since childhood, able to endure injuries ordinary people cannot.

deep_breath.name: Long Breath
deep_breath.description: Long, steady breathing; able to hold a single breath longer than peers.

keen_sense.name: Keen-Eyed
keen_sense.description: Likely to spot traces that others miss.

light_step.name: Light-Footed
light_step.description: Nimble on your feet, moving half a beat faster than others.

sharp_strike.name: Sharp Strike
sharp_strike.description: Once you strike, the blows hit harder than they appear.

tough_frame.name: Tough Frame
tough_frame.description: Unusually solid flesh and bone, not easily broken even after taking a direct blow.

armor.middle.rare.description: Plates settle beneath cloth; tightened straps answer with a short, muffled sound.
armor.middle.rare.background: Armor sellers ask customers to sit and raise their arms. Protection that only looks right while standing soon betrays itself.

condensed_blade.description: Spread qi narrows into a line; the wrist must settle before release.
condensed_blade.background: The old instructors wound hemp rope around a post. A pupil moved on only when the sword qi cut the rope and left the wood unmarked.

fire_bolt.description: A point of heat gathers beside the palm before leaving on a compressed breath.
fire_bolt.background: Beginners learn to keep it clear of their sleeves. Singed cuffs last longer than boasts about flawless practice.

flame_wave.description: Flame spreads across the space ahead; the eye cannot stay fixed on the nearest point.
flame_wave.background: Practice grounds mark several positions, reminding novices not to chase a spreading form back into a single line.

formation.attack.middle.description: Carved channels gather inward; small edge notches help alignment.
formation.attack.middle.background: Array users test an empty place on the ground before laying it down. Fine carving cannot choose the terrain for them.

heavy_thunder.description: Thunder gathers heavily within; the opening is small, the recovery hard to neglect.
heavy_thunder.background: Onlookers remember the noise. Someone who has used it first works the stiffness from their fingers.

implement.lower.common.description: A plain blade carries fine bright marks from repeated sharpening near the root.
implement.lower.common.background: Ordinary cases fit it and repair stalls know its faults. Many first journeys begin with a sword much like this.

implement.middle.rare.description: Its lines are cleaner than common iron; a small push at the scabbard mouth gives a clear ring.
implement.middle.rare.background: Buyers admire the bluish edge; smiths check the spine. The argument over price can last an entire pot of tea.

implement.top.unique.description: A celebrated name rests quietly in an unadorned case.
implement.top.unique.background: Some bow to the name; others ask its keeper about maintenance. Once it is lifted, every story must leave room for the hand that holds it.

implement.upper.rare.effect.description: The grip has darkened with age while fine paths beneath the blade remain clear as an old mountain trail.
implement.upper.rare.effect.background: Repairers hesitate to recut those lines. An old sword asks not merely how to remove rust, but which marks should remain.

material.herb.green_vine.description: Green stems curl around leaf veins, retaining an astringent smell after drying.
material.herb.green_vine.background: Buyers separate roots from dirt before weighing. Damp soil in a basket can turn a small sale into a street-long argument.

material.ore.iron.description: A rough fracture shows heavy metallic glints within dark stone.
material.ore.iron.background: A furnace apprentice first learns which pieces not to tip in together. Much of smelting happens before the fire is lit.

material.stone.ward.description: Dense stone leaves fine grinding dust on knuckles and chisel edges.
material.stone.ward.background: Array-material cutters choose the grain for the first strike. The quiet decision determines whether the whole block remains useful.

material.talisman.ink.description: The cinnabar mixture leaves a fine red film around the bowl after stirring.
material.talisman.ink.background: Grinding dislikes impatience. A seller may praise it endlessly, but the first touch of a brush reveals its texture.

material.talisman.paper.description: Dense fibers become visible against the light.
material.talisman.paper.background: Many workshops sacrifice a corner to test ink first. Cheap material does not cause smaller failures merely because it is cheap.

meridian_secret_blade.description: The blade has not moved, but the meridians draw taut as a bowstring.
meridian_secret_blade.background: The release instructions are short; recovery fills the reverse page. Read only how to strike and you miss the heavier half of the method.

method.basic_breathing.description: Breathing is like straightening a wavering lamp: undramatic, but never unattended.
method.basic_breathing.background: Beginner copies often sketch crooked shoulders more carefully than meridians. Anyone who has taught a novice knows where the first difficult breath begins.
method.basic_breathing.name: Basic Breathing

method.body_cycle.description: Breath travels close along muscle and bone; the cloth across the back is often soaked by the final stance.
method.body_cycle.background: The diagrams plant their feet heavily rather than floating. This old furnace of a body is worked repeatedly, not replaced by a clever formula.
method.body_cycle.name: Body-Tempering Circuit

method.clear_mind.description: Focus does not banish every sound; it distinguishes them, then leaves them outside the mind.
method.clear_mind.background: The small lines before the main exercise often wear first. They remind the reader that stillness is not always silence.
method.clear_mind.name: Clear Mind Contemplation

method.cold_spring.description: Circulation asks for the attention of someone carrying a nearly full bowl of cold spring water.
method.cold_spring.background: Some copies space the pauses generously, preferring blank paper to a pupil mistaking cold circulation for simply holding their breath.
method.cold_spring.name: Cold Spring Circulation

method.economical_breath.description: Breaths are measured like the last water in a traveler’s skin.
method.economical_breath.background: Its short pages favor stopping points over grand theory. Those who wear them out first need not be the most gifted.
method.economical_breath.name: Economical Breathing

method.flowing_wind.description: Each breath leaves room for the next step; a turn feels like wind through an unlatched door.
method.flowing_wind.background: Practice pages sometimes carry shoe dust. Apparent lightness may have been learned through countless careful retreats in a cramped courtyard.
method.flowing_wind.name: Flowing Wind Circulation

method.origin_guard.description: Qi gathers in measured layers; movement begins with a settled footing.
method.origin_guard.background: Teachers may ask pupils to sit and stand with a stool. Keeping one’s shape is not a lesson reserved for being struck.
method.origin_guard.name: Origin Guard Circulation

method.spirit_beast_breathing.description: The body rises and settles as qi follows instinct, with no scripture to read.
method.spirit_beast_breathing.background: Keepers learn to distinguish sleep from cultivation through the enclosure rails. Breathing is universal; cultivation is not automatic.
method.spirit_beast_breathing.name: Instinctive Breathing

method.warm_origin.description: The breath warms without rushing, like gathering an overnight hearth back to life.
method.warm_origin.background: An old copy circles “warm” twice, then notes: “Hotter is not better.” Impatient students tend to miss the annotation.
method.warm_origin.name: Warm Origin Circulation

pill.boost.attack.middle.description: The reddish dose leaves a sharp scent inside its seal.
pill.boost.attack.middle.background: An apothecary adds a separate label against mistakes in the dark. That scrap of paper is often more useful than praise of the formula.

pill.restore.health.lower.description: Breaking the wax releases a bitter herbal smell; the pellet is not perfectly smooth.
pill.restore.health.lower.background: Shop assistants leave a place to crack the seal. In real urgency, nobody stops to admire the stamp.

pill.support.cultivation.lower.description: Fine powder rests in a paper packet that sheds a faint medicinal dust.
pill.support.cultivation.lower.background: Before retreat, people count packets before provisions. An unremarkable purchase may accompany days quieter than any journey.

shield.description: A thin light rests before the body like paper drawn taut by the hand.
shield.background: Novices want to tap it with a knuckle. Teachers ask them to dismiss and gather it first: a guard has a beginning and an end.

strike.description: A plain action joins the weapon in hand to a firmly placed step.
strike.background: A roadside boxer calls the swing too wide; an old escort calls the recovery too slow. Both mean not to give the next moment away.

talisman.ward.lower.description: Thin paper darkens where cinnabar strokes turn; fingers should avoid the inked face.
talisman.ward.lower.background: Shop stacks are still counted sheet by sheet. Travelers fold one into a coat; others tuck one into a letter home.

treasure.attack.middle.description: The small treasure sits quietly by the palm, its edges finished with precision.
treasure.attack.middle.background: The difficult finishing work lies on the reverse. Spectators ask how far it travels; craftspeople turn it over first.

treasure.defense.middle.description: Closely layered patterns feel different at the center and rim.
treasure.defense.middle.background: Its maker left room for the rim to close cleanly, like fitting a hinge to a frequently opened door. Invisible work can take longer than ornament.

treasure.support.upper.effect.description: Its restrained fine pattern can pass for an unremarkable personal object at rest.
treasure.support.upper.effect.background: Searchers and trackers seldom dress it in extravagant cases. Its worth is judged at a confusing fork, not under a shop lamp.

method.core_continuation.description: Gather scattered spiritual power into a steadier inner circulation.
method.core_continuation.background: A continuation manual compiled by Core Formation cultivators; its keeper must still agree to teach it.
method.core_continuation.name: Core-Nurturing Circulation

method.nascent_continuation.description: Turn spiritual awareness inward and follow each current through the dantian.
method.nascent_continuation.background: Advanced contemplation requires a complete teaching, not merely knowledge of the manual's title.
method.nascent_continuation.name: Nascent Contemplation

method.spirit_continuation.description: Deep circulation steadies the body as awareness extends and returns.
method.spirit_continuation.background: Only complete advanced instruction reveals the crucial steps; fragments and rumors do not suffice.
method.spirit_continuation.name: Spirit-Consolidating Circulation

method.void_unification.description: Unite the five elemental currents and release them as a concentrated edge.
method.void_unification.background: A Spirit Realm continuation whose prerequisites and long study cannot be replaced by a legendary name.
method.void_unification.name: Five-Element Spatial Tempering

method.integration_return.description: Bind power and body through patient, grounded circulation.
method.integration_return.background: A defensive Body Integration continuation passed on through sustained instruction and study.
method.integration_return.name: Integrated Origin Return

method.mahayana_insight.description: Patient contemplation separates the world's tangled spiritual currents.
method.mahayana_insight.background: A Grand Ascension continuation that promises neither automatic ascension nor freedom from risk.
method.mahayana_insight.name: Grand Ascension Insight

foundation_pierce.name: Foundation Focused Strike
foundation_pierce.description: Light gathers between the fingers into a narrow point, held still for a breath before release.
foundation_pierce.background: A practical art passed among cultivators of this realm. Teachers begin with control and recovery, not a dazzling first strike.

foundation_wave.name: Foundation Flame Wave
foundation_wave.description: Flame divides before the caster, whose attention must follow several movements at once.

equipment.foundation_blade.name: Foundation Spirit Blade
equipment.foundation_blade.description: A plain scabbard conceals close-set marks near the blade root and a quiet, concentrated edge. Once powered, its etched edge works through protective force. That penetrating capacity belongs to the weapon and does not grow without limit with its owner.
equipment.foundation_blade.background: A blade made for this realm. Its examiner tests the demands of control before admiring the finish.

equipment.foundation_robe.name: Foundation Spirit Robe
equipment.foundation_robe.description: A supple robe hides interwoven spiritual patterns in its lining without weighing down its hem. When powered, its woven channels ease the strain of casting. That support weakens as the wearer outgrows the robe’s rated capacity.
equipment.foundation_robe.background: A familiar protective design for this realm. Its fine patterns still demand attention while the wearer faces danger.

equipment.foundation_mirror.name: Foundation Clarity Focus
equipment.foundation_mirror.description: The mirror gives a poor reflection, but tilting it reveals faint, layered traces of light.
equipment.foundation_mirror.background: An aid to perception for this realm. Its holder must still interpret what appears; a glance does not reveal another person’s secrets.

method.core_wind_path.background: An assertive continuation for this realm, taught through coordinated movement and attack rather than unthinking aggression.

material.spirit.boundary_anchor.name: Boundary anchor
material.spirit.boundary_anchor.description: Three pieces of gray jade form a ring marked for this boundary wind.
material.spirit.boundary_anchor.background: Thirty days of preparation bind it to this surveyed window. Crossing consumes it; it is not a purchased travel ticket.

material.spirit.boundary_jade.name: Boundary jade
material.spirit.boundary_jade.description: A blue line lies within gray-white jade, cool to the touch with flat cutting marks.
material.spirit.boundary_jade.background: Suppliers wrap it separately and distinguish raw jade from a prepared anchor. It can also stabilize a broken vein for a short passage.

manual.spirit.void.name: Spatial Tempering Three-Path Manual
manual.spirit.void.description: Three jade volumes are tied with blue cord, with tested notes beside the circulation diagrams.
manual.spirit.void.background: Contains the Five-Phase continuation, Wind and Still paths, plus the Piercing, Wave and Ward arts of Spatial Tempering. Possession permits study; qualification and time are still required.

manual.spirit.integration.name: Integration Three-Path Manual
manual.spirit.integration.description: Thick jade leaves carry channel diagrams and equipment annotations, their edges worn smooth.
manual.spirit.integration.background: Contains the Integration continuation, Wind and Still paths and three matching arts. A complete copy can be recovered from the old watch array or purchased in the southern market.

manual.spirit.mahayana.name: Grand Ascension Three-Path Manual
manual.spirit.mahayana.description: Thin golden leaves lie between plain white jade boards, with small marks from repeated comparison.
manual.spirit.mahayana.background: Contains the Grand Ascension continuation, Wind and Still paths and three matching arts. It is complete study material, not proof of a breakthrough or guaranteed ascension.

material.spirit.rift_sample.name: Broken-vein sample
material.spirit.rift_sample.description: A faint five-colored line crosses its fracture, wrapped in cloth marked during collection.
material.spirit.rift_sample.background: Collected on this expedition and available for Qiao Yan to examine in person. Holding it does not disclose the whole journey to the camp.

material.spirit.formation_record.name: Watch-array record
material.spirit.formation_record.description: Tough sheets mark array positions, with handwritten measurements beside gaps.
material.spirit.formation_record.background: Records a real intervention at the watch array. Preservation and dismantling leave different histories; Lu pays the agreed examination fee once.

material.spirit.ancient_rubbing.name: Old inscription rubbing
material.spirit.ancient_rubbing.description: Folded rubbing paper is pale at its creases, its uneven ink held flat by thin bamboo strips.
material.spirit.ancient_rubbing.background: The older layer preserved during thirty days of copying can be examined with Ning. She welcomes new readings without requiring a traveler to repeat an ancient life.
